金正恩视察边境旅游区 其妹妹和女儿一起滑雪

朝鲜领导人金正恩近日视察靠近中国边境的三池渊山区旅游区，检查机场、铁路及滑雪度假村等设施的建设进度，并要求确保各项工程达到最高质量标准。

路透社引述朝中社星期二（17日）报道，金正恩视察了三池渊机场改建工程、旅游铁路和滑雪度假村，并对当地酒店、旅馆和住宅的建设情况表示满意。他也登上白头山，查看重建的缆车站和天池周边工程。

与此同时，朝鲜劳动党中央委员会书记赵甬元率团访问俄罗斯，并与俄罗斯总统普京会面。

美国总统特朗普星期一称，他本周访问中国期间，可能与金正恩会面。克里姆林宫也说，如果金正恩前往中国出席亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会，普京可能与他会晤。

韩国统一部指出，朝鲜代表团在美中俄元首峰会前夕访俄，韩方将密切关注相关动向。

items.body:
高市与中国部长握手交谈 为中日关系恶化后首次公开互动

日本首相高市早苗星期二（11月17日）在菲律宾马尼拉出席亚细安与中日韩领导人会议期间，与一名中国部长握手并简短交谈。这是自去年底中日关系恶化以来，她首次与中国政府官员公开互动。

据彭博社报道，活动官方视频显示，高市在会议开始前，向中国农业农村部部长张柱致意。作为出席会议的最高级别中国官员，张柱随后起身与高市握手，两人简短交谈了几句。

此次互动发生在高市即将以日本首相身份首次访华之前。高市将前往中国深圳，出席星期三至星期四（11月18日至19日）举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议，讨论包括贸易、能源韧性和人工智能在内的区域经济问题。

过去一年来，中日关系持续紧张，各界紧密关注高市与中国国家主席习近平到时是否会有任何互动。不过，分析员一般认为，两位领导人不大可能举行双边会谈。

去年11月初，高市在国会中说，若中国大陆对台湾动武，日本可能面对“存亡危机”而可行使集体自卫权。这番谈话引来中方严厉批评，认为是在挑战中国国家主权，双边关系顿陷僵冷。

南非要求台湾代表处迁址未果 双方僵持三年

南非政府指台湾无视迁址要求，至今仍未将驻南非代表处从行政首都比勒陀利亚迁往约翰内斯堡，使双方持续三年的外交争端陷入僵局。台湾则强调，在双方达成协议前，代表处将继续在原址运作。

据彭博社星期二（11月17日）报道，南非外交部长拉莫拉在书面答复国会质询时指出，尽管南非政府已采取多项措施，包括去年7月单方面将台湾代表处降级，并更名为“台北商务办事处”，但该机构至今仍在比勒陀利亚运作。

拉莫拉说，台湾代表处所在建筑仍悬挂“台北联络代表处”的招牌，并继续享有税务豁免等特权。他强调，要求台湾代表处迁址的决定“没有谈判余地”，在逻辑和政治上都势在必行。

彭博社此前引述台湾外交部官员透露，南非早在2023年主办中国国家主席习近平出席的金砖国家峰会后，便开始施压要求台湾迁移代表处。

台湾外交部发言人萧光伟星期二回应说，台湾始终以务实态度与南非交涉，并呼吁南非展现民主法治国家的风范，不应该试图借由地方政府，以强制手段来逼迫台湾迁处。

萧光伟透露，台湾近期已正式回复南非外交部，并就协商方式提出具体建议，希望双方尽快展开理性协商，寻求妥适的解决方式。不过，在双方达成协议前，台湾代表处将继续在比勒陀利亚运作。

拉莫拉透露，南非政府正与比勒陀利亚所属的茨瓦内都会市政府协商，寻求“合法且符合外交规范”的方式落实迁址要求，以避免引发法律诉讼或国际争议。

不过，由于台湾拥有代表处所在建筑，南非宪法对财产权的保障限制了政府强制迁址的能力。

这场争端也牵动双方经贸关系。台湾去年9月曾宣布对输往南非的晶片等47项产品实施出口管制，涉及当地汽车及科技产业所需的关键零部件。不过，在南非同意展开正式谈判后，台湾随即暂缓实施有关措施。

时隔一年多，双方谈判仍未取得突破。拉莫拉说，南非正继续推动签署新的双方安排备忘录，以规范贸易、投资及文化关系，并希望结束南非政府持续遭台湾方面无视的局面。

items.summary: 卡尼再次访华，中国会是加拿大摆脱美国依赖的答案吗？ Telegraph | 原文链接 | 频道大全
items.body:
IAN AUSTEN2026年11月17日

加拿大总理马克·卡尼周六在马尼拉出席新闻发布会，他此行是为参加东南亚国家联盟峰会。 Ian Austen/The New York Times

The importance of Europe to Prime Minister Mark Carney’s plan to diversify Canada’s economy and politics away from its reliance on the United States was underscored last week by his travel schedule.

上周，马克·卡尼总理的行程凸显了欧洲对于他推动加拿大经济和政治多元化、减少对美国依赖的计划的重要性。

Mr. Carney added a stop in Dublin, joining a meeting of European leaders before the start of a previously planned trip to Asia.

卡尼在先前计划的亚洲之行开始前增加了都柏林一站，参加欧洲领导人会议。

Last month Mr. Carney announced that Canada is officially seeking to become the first “associate member” of the European Union. But experts say that Asia offers the greater economic opportunity.

上月，卡尼宣布加拿大正式寻求成为欧盟首个“准成员国”。但专家表示，亚洲提供更大的经济机遇。

“Prime Minister Carney certainly seems to have a strong focus on Europe, which gives an impression that he is not looking toward Asia,” said Kazuto Suzuki, a professor at the University of Tokyo’s graduate school of public policy. “Nevertheless, if Canada is to avoid dependence on the U.S. market and form a coalition of middle powers, cooperation with Asia is essential.”

“卡尼总理似乎确实非常关注欧洲，这给人一种他不看向亚洲的印象，”东京大学公共政策研究生院教授铃木一人说。“然而，如果加拿大要避免依赖美国市场并组建中等强国联盟，与亚洲合作至关重要。”

Last year, Mr. Carney was something of a curiosity at the meetings of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations and the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum. But his speech in January at the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and President Trump’s addition of energy security threats to his trade war with the world have made Mr. Carney and his energy-rich country a marquee attraction at both.

去年，卡尼在东南亚国家联盟和亚太经合组织论坛的会议上还是个新鲜面孔。但他今年1月在瑞士达沃斯世界经济论坛上的演讲，以及特朗普总统将能源安全威胁加入其与世界的贸易战，使卡尼和他资源丰富的国家成为这两个场景下备受瞩目的焦点。

卡尼于1月在北京会见了中国国家主席习近平。他本周将再次与习近平会面。

Before the APEC meeting in Shenzhen, China, this week, Mr. Carney will have his second formal meeting this year with China’s leader, Xi Jinping. And Mr. Carney, who is as fond of free trade agreements as Mr. Trump is of tariffs, announced in Manila before the ASEAN meetings opened that Canada had completed the broad negotiations for a deal with the Philippines. Talks are also underway on a wider trade arrangement with all 11 ASEAN countries.

本周在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织会议前，卡尼将与中国领导人习近平举行今年第二次正式会晤。卡尼对自由贸易协定的热衷程度恰如特朗普对关税的热衷，在东盟会议开幕前，他在马尼拉宣布，加拿大已完成为与菲律宾达成协议的广泛谈判。此外，与所有11个东盟国家达成更广泛贸易安排的谈判也在进行中。

On Saturday, Mr. Carney said that at both summits he would press his call for “middle powers” to unite and would present Canada as a reliable alternative to an increasingly unpredictable United States as a supplier of important products like oil and gas.

周六，卡尼表示，在两个峰会上，他都将呼吁“中等强国”团结起来，并将加拿大塑造成一个可靠的替代选择——在石油和天然气等重要产品的供应方面，加拿大可以替代日益难以预测的美国。

“It’s part of our strategy, absolutely, 100 percent,” Mr. Carney said at a news conference after meeting with President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. of the Philippines. “We’re very transparent about it. It’s a part of our strategy to develop this dense web of connections to make us resilient, to make us more independent, to make us sovereign so we can live our lives as we choose, so we’re not being told what to do by some hegemon or a hyperscaler.”

“这绝对是我们战略的一部分，百分之百，”卡尼在与菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯会晤后的新闻发布会上说。“我们对此非常透明。这是我们战略的一部分——发展这张密集的联系网络使我们有韧性，使我们更独立，使我们拥有主权，以便我们能按自己选择的方式生活，而不是被某个霸权或超级巨头指手画脚。”

卡尼于周六抵达马尼拉。

“It is to varying degrees part of the strategies of many, many countries,” he added, “and that’s one of the reasons why you’re seeing so much progress.”

“这在不同程度上是许多许多国家战略的一部分，”他还说，“这也是你们看到如此多进展的原因之一。”

Between the Asia summits, Mr. Carney made a quick stop in Cambodia, which is hosting a meeting of the International Organization of Francophonie, an association that promotes French language and culture. There, he received noticeably more applause than anyone else when the leaders were introduced.

在两个亚洲峰会之间，卡尼短暂造访柬埔寨。柬埔寨正在主办国际法语国家组织会议，该组织致力于推广法语和法国文化。会上，在领导人介绍环节，他获得的掌声明显比其他任何人都多。

During the APEC meeting, however, Mr. Carney will come up hard against superpower politics. Mr. Xi will host a meeting with President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia and Mr. Trump. Mr. Putin’s appearance, after he skipped last year’s APEC meeting in South Korea, is a stark contrast with the European Political Community summit in Dublin. There, Mr. Carney and his European counterparts reaffirmed their unqualified support for Ukraine at a meeting also attended by its leader, President Volodymyr Zelensky.

然而，在亚太经合组织会议期间，卡尼将直面超级大国政治的严峻考验。习近平主席将主持一场由俄罗斯总统普京和特朗普共同出席的会议。普京缺席了去年韩国亚太经合组织会议，他此次出席将使这次会议与都柏林欧洲政治共同体峰会形成鲜明对比。在都柏林峰会上，卡尼及其欧洲同行们重申了对乌克兰的无条件支持，乌克兰领导人泽连斯基总统也出席了该会议。

卡尼于9月在阿尔伯塔省班夫与乌克兰总统泽连斯基会面。

Mr. Carney said he would pose for a group photograph of the APEC leaders with Mr. Putin “out of respect for the host.”

卡尼说，他将“出于对东道主的尊重”，与普京一起参加亚太经合组织领导人合影。

But that appears to be Mr. Carney’s limit. He again noted on Saturday that Canada would bar Russian and Belarusian teams from entering the country for the Men’s World Junior Hockey Championship at the end of the year.

但这似乎是卡尼的极限。周六他再次指出，加拿大将禁止俄罗斯和白俄罗斯队入境参加年底的男子世界青年冰球锦标赛。

“Canada stands firmly with Ukraine, firmly with democracy, territorial integrity, rule of law,” he said. “All of those put us on the other side of Vladimir Putin’s Russia.”

“加拿大坚定地与乌克兰站在一起，坚定地与民主、领土完整、法治站在一起，”他说。“所有这些都使我们站在弗拉基米尔·普京的俄罗斯的对立面。”

Canada’s relationship with China, the biggest potential market for replacing trade with the United States, was sulfurous before Mr. Carney, a former governor of the Bank of Canada and the Bank of England, entered politics last year.

在曾任加拿大央行行长和英格兰银行行长的卡尼去年进入政坛之前，加拿大与中国的关系一直十分紧张，中国是取代与美国贸易的最大潜在市场。

It collapsed after China arrested two Canadians in what was widely seen in Canada as hostage-taking in retaliation for Canada’s arrest of a Chinese telecommunications executive on a U.S. extradition request. An inquiry also concluded that China had tried to interfere in Canadian politics.

在中国逮捕两名加拿大公民后，两国关系崩溃。加拿大普遍认为这是人质扣押行为，是对加拿大应美国引渡请求逮捕一名中国电信行业高管的报复。一项调查还得出结论，中国试图干预加拿大政治。

Polls suggest that Canadians’ good will toward China has risen since Mr. Carney re-established relations. At the same time, their views of the United States under Mr. Trump, who started a trade war and continues to suggest that Canada should be the 51st American state, have moved decidedly in the other direction.

民调显示，自卡尼重建关系以来，加拿大人对中国的好感有所上升。与此同时，他们对特朗普治下美国的看法明显朝相反方向转变——特朗普发动贸易战，并不断提出加拿大应成为美国第51个州。

But Mr. Carney will be limited in how far he can go with China. A poll by the nonprofit Angus Reid Institute found that only 14 percent of Canadians favor closer trade ties with China. By contrast, 58 percent of respondents want to increase trade ties with Europe.

但卡尼与中国交往的程度将受到限制。非营利机构安格斯·里德研究所的一项民调发现，只有14%的加拿大人支持与中国建立更密切的贸易关系。相比之下，58%的受访者希望增加与欧洲的贸易关系。

In January, after meeting with Mr. Xi, Mr. Carney predicted that Chinese automakers would make substantial investments in Canada within three years.

今年1月与习近平会晤后，卡尼预测，中国汽车制造商将在三年内在加拿大进行大量投资。

On Saturday, however, he was more circumspect. While the government wants “a competitive Canadian auto sector that produces good-paying jobs, good union jobs for Canadian workers,” he said, it also wants Canadians to have access to affordable electric cars.

然而，周六他表现得更为谨慎。他说，虽然政府希望“一个有竞争力的加拿大汽车行业，为加拿大工人提供高薪工作、良好的工会工作”，但也希望加拿大人能买得起价格可负担的电动汽车。

“There are multiple variables, and there’s multiple ways to achieve those objectives,” he said. “It depends partially on — and importantly on — where the U.S. trading relationship settles out.”

“有多个变量，也有多种方式实现这些目标，”他说。“这部分取决于——而且重要的是取决于——与美国的贸易关系最终如何落定。”

Ian Austen为时报报道加拿大新闻，常驻渥太华。他报道加拿大的政治、文化和与加拿大人有关的新闻已有20年。欢迎通过电邮austen@nytimes.com与他联系。

“Prime Minister Carney certainly seems to have a strong focus on Europe, which gives an impression that he is not looking toward Asia,” said Kazuto Suzuki, a professor at the University of Tokyo’s graduate school of public policy. “Nevertheless, if Canada is to avoid dependence on the U.S. market and form a coalition of middle powers, cooperation with Asia is essential.”
“卡尼总理似乎确实非常关注欧洲，这给人一种他不看向亚洲的印象，”东京大学公共政策研究生院教授铃木一人说。“然而，如果加拿大要避免依赖美国市场并组建中等强国联盟，与亚洲合作至关重要。”

Last year, Mr. Carney was something of a curiosity at the meetings of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations and the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum. But his speech in January at the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and President Trump’s addition of energy security threats to his trade war with the world have made Mr. Carney and his energy-rich country a marquee attraction at both.
去年，卡尼在东南亚国家联盟和亚太经合组织论坛的会议上还是个新鲜面孔。但他今年1月在瑞士达沃斯世界经济论坛上的演讲，以及特朗普总统将能源安全威胁加入其与世界的贸易战，使卡尼和他资源丰富的国家成为这两个场景下备受瞩目的焦点。
卡尼于1月在北京会见了中国国家主席习近平。他本周将再次与习近平会面。

Before the APEC meeting in Shenzhen, China, this week, Mr. Carney will have his second formal meeting this year with China’s leader, Xi Jinping. And Mr. Carney, who is as fond of free trade agreements as Mr. Trump is of tariffs, announced in Manila before the ASEAN meetings opened that Canada had completed the broad negotiations for a deal with the Philippines. Talks are also underway on a wider trade arrangement with all 11 ASEAN countries.
本周在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织会议前，卡尼将与中国领导人习近平举行今年第二次正式会晤。卡尼对自由贸易协定的热衷程度恰如特朗普对关税的热衷，在东盟会议开幕前，他在马尼拉宣布，加拿大已完成为与菲律宾达成协议的广泛谈判。此外，与所有11个东盟国家达成更广泛贸易安排的谈判也在进行中。

On Saturday, Mr. Carney said that at both summits he would press his call for “middle powers” to unite and would present Canada as a reliable alternative to an increasingly unpredictable United States as a supplier of important products like oil and gas.
周六，卡尼表示，在两个峰会上，他都将呼吁“中等强国”团结起来，并将加拿大塑造成一个可靠的替代选择——在石油和天然气等重要产品的供应方面，加拿大可以替代日益难以预测的美国。

“It’s part of our strategy, absolutely, 100 percent,” Mr. Carney said at a news conference after meeting with President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. of the Philippines. “We’re very transparent about it. It’s a part of our strategy to develop this dense web of connections to make us resilient, to make us more independent, to make us sovereign so we can live our lives as we choose, so we’re not being told what to do by some hegemon or a hyperscaler.”
“这绝对是我们战略的一部分，百分之百，”卡尼在与菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯会晤后的新闻发布会上说。“我们对此非常透明。这是我们战略的一部分——发展这张密集的联系网络使我们有韧性，使我们更独立，使我们拥有主权，以便我们能按自己选择的方式生活，而不是被某个霸权或超级巨头指手画脚。”
卡尼于周六抵达马尼拉。
“It is to varying degrees part of the strategies of many, many countries,” he added, “and that’s one of the reasons why you’re seeing so much progress.”
“这在不同程度上是许多许多国家战略的一部分，”他还说，“这也是你们看到如此多进展的原因之一。”

Between the Asia summits, Mr. Carney made a quick stop in Cambodia, which is hosting a meeting of the International Organization of Francophonie, an association that promotes French language and culture. There, he received noticeably more applause than anyone else when the leaders were introduced.
在两个亚洲峰会之间，卡尼短暂造访柬埔寨。柬埔寨正在主办国际法语国家组织会议，该组织致力于推广法语和法国文化。会上，在领导人介绍环节，他获得的掌声明显比其他任何人都多。

During the APEC meeting, however, Mr. Carney will come up hard against superpower politics. Mr. Xi will host a meeting with President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia and Mr. Trump. Mr. Putin’s appearance, after he skipped last year’s APEC meeting in South Korea, is a stark contrast with the European Political Community summit in Dublin. There, Mr. Carney and his European counterparts reaffirmed their unqualified support for Ukraine at a meeting also attended by its leader, President Volodymyr Zelensky.
然而，在亚太经合组织会议期间，卡尼将直面超级大国政治的严峻考验。习近平主席将主持一场由俄罗斯总统普京和特朗普共同出席的会议。普京缺席了去年韩国亚太经合组织会议，他此次出席将使这次会议与都柏林欧洲政治共同体峰会形成鲜明对比。在都柏林峰会上，卡尼及其欧洲同行们重申了对乌克兰的无条件支持，乌克兰领导人泽连斯基总统也出席了该会议。
卡尼于9月在阿尔伯塔省班夫与乌克兰总统泽连斯基会面。
Mr. Carney said he would pose for a group photograph of the APEC leaders with Mr. Putin “out of respect for the host.”
卡尼说，他将“出于对东道主的尊重”，与普京一起参加亚太经合组织领导人合影。

But that appears to be Mr. Carney’s limit. He again noted on Saturday that Canada would bar Russian and Belarusian teams from entering the country for the Men’s World Junior Hockey Championship at the end of the year.
但这似乎是卡尼的极限。周六他再次指出，加拿大将禁止俄罗斯和白俄罗斯队入境参加年底的男子世界青年冰球锦标赛。
“Canada stands firmly with Ukraine, firmly with democracy, territorial integrity, rule of law,” he said. “All of those put us on the other side of Vladimir Putin’s Russia.”
“加拿大坚定地与乌克兰站在一起，坚定地与民主、领土完整、法治站在一起，”他说。“所有这些都使我们站在弗拉基米尔·普京的俄罗斯的对立面。”

Canada’s relationship with China, the biggest potential market for replacing trade with the United States, was sulfurous before Mr. Carney, a former governor of the Bank of Canada and the Bank of England, entered politics last year.
在曾任加拿大央行行长和英格兰银行行长的卡尼去年进入政坛之前，加拿大与中国的关系一直十分紧张，中国是取代与美国贸易的最大潜在市场。

It collapsed after China arrested two Canadians in what was widely seen in Canada as hostage-taking in retaliation for Canada’s arrest of a Chinese telecommunications executive on a U.S. extradition request. An inquiry also concluded that China had tried to interfere in Canadian politics.
在中国逮捕两名加拿大公民后，两国关系崩溃。加拿大普遍认为这是人质扣押行为，是对加拿大应美国引渡请求逮捕一名中国电信行业高管的报复。一项调查还得出结论，中国试图干预加拿大政治。

Polls suggest that Canadians’ good will toward China has risen since Mr. Carney re-established relations. At the same time, their views of the United States under Mr. Trump, who started a trade war and continues to suggest that Canada should be the 51st American state, have moved decidedly in the other direction.
民调显示，自卡尼重建关系以来，加拿大人对中国的好感有所上升。与此同时，他们对特朗普治下美国的看法明显朝相反方向转变——特朗普发动贸易战，并不断提出加拿大应成为美国第51个州。

But Mr. Carney will be limited in how far he can go with China. A poll by the nonprofit Angus Reid Institute found that only 14 percent of Canadians favor closer trade ties with China. By contrast, 58 percent of respondents want to increase trade ties with Europe.
但卡尼与中国交往的程度将受到限制。非营利机构安格斯·里德研究所的一项民调发现，只有14%的加拿大人支持与中国建立更密切的贸易关系。相比之下，58%的受访者希望增加与欧洲的贸易关系。
In January, after meeting with Mr. Xi, Mr. Carney predicted that Chinese automakers would make substantial investments in Canada within three years.
今年1月与习近平会晤后，卡尼预测，中国汽车制造商将在三年内在加拿大进行大量投资。

On Saturday, however, he was more circumspect. While the government wants “a competitive Canadian auto sector that produces good-paying jobs, good union jobs for Canadian workers,” he said, it also wants Canadians to have access to affordable electric cars.
然而，周六他表现得更为谨慎。他说，虽然政府希望“一个有竞争力的加拿大汽车行业，为加拿大工人提供高薪工作、良好的工会工作”，但也希望加拿大人能买得起价格可负担的电动汽车。
“There are multiple variables, and there’s multiple ways to achieve those objectives,” he said. “It depends partially on — and importantly on — where the U.S. trading relationship settles out.”
“有多个变量，也有多种方式实现这些目标，”他说。“这部分取决于——而且重要的是取决于——与美国的贸易关系最终如何落定。”
Ian Austen为时报报道加拿大新闻，常驻渥太华。他报道加拿大的政治、文化和与加拿大人有关的新闻已有20年。欢迎通过电邮austen@nytimes.com与他联系。

ALAN RAPPEPORT, ANA SWANSON2026年11月17日

President Trump heads to Asia on Monday for high-stakes meetings with foreign leaders aimed at ending Russia’s war in Ukraine and smoothing over trade frictions with China. But the most tense meeting could take place aboard Air Force One.

特朗普总统周一启程前往亚洲，将与外国领导人举行一系列事关重大的会晤，希望结束俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争，并缓和美中贸易摩擦。但最紧张的一场会面可能就发生在“空军一号”上。

Sequestered together on the journey across the world will be Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Howard Lutnick, the commerce secretary, whose long-running rivalry has recently spilled into the open.

在这段跨越大半个地球的行程中，财政部长斯科特·贝森特与商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克将被迫“困”在同一个机舱——两人由来已久的竞争关系近期已公开化。

Mr. Lutnick is under fire for slow-walking several measures aimed at clamping down on the supply of Nvidia chips to foreign data centers that serve Chinese clients. The controversy has put Mr. Lutnick at odds with Mr. Bessent, who has increasingly taken a hard line on China. While Mr. Lutnick has pushed for policies more favorable to Nvidia, Mr. Bessent has played the foil, going so far as to call for a dramatic shake-up of the company’s leadership.

卢特尼克正因拖延多项措施的推进饱受批评，这些措施旨在遏制向服务中国客户的外国数据中心供应英伟达芯片。这一争议使卢特尼克与对华立场日益强硬的贝森特产生了分歧。卢特尼克一直在推动更有利于英伟达的政策，贝森特则扮演了截然相反的角色，甚至呼吁对该公司领导层进行大幅改组。

The Treasury secretary traditionally manages America’s economic relationship with China. After spending much of last year trying to de-escalate tension between the world’s two largest economies over tariffs, Mr. Bessent has taken a more hawkish stance this year amid growing concern over the artificial intelligence race with China and risks that rogue Chinese A.I. technology could pose to the U.S. economy.

传统上，美国对华经济关系由财政部长负责管理。去年大部分时间里，贝森特都在努力缓和全球前两大经济体之间因关税引发的紧张局势；但今年，随着关于中美人工智能竞赛以及中国人工智能技术可能对美国经济构成的风险的担忧日益加剧，他的立场变得更加鹰派。

The internal clash over China policy has echoes of Mr. Trump’s first term, when the president’s economic advisers regularly argued about how forcefully to confront China over its trade practices. After Mr. Trump imposed steep tariffs on Chinese imports last year, Mr. Bessent called for de-escalation and helped broker a trade truce that stabilized the global economy.

围绕对华政策的内部冲突与特朗普第一任期内的情形颇为相似，当时总统的经济顾问们经常争论是否应就中国的贸易行为与其强硬对抗。去年特朗普对中国输美商品加征高额关税后，贝森特曾呼吁局势降温，并协助斡旋达成了一项稳定全球经济的贸易休战协议。

But in recent months, the Trump administration has been frustrated that China has not lived up to its commitments for purchases of American farm products and to accelerate exports of its critical minerals, which are needed for making high-tech electronics and military equipment.

但近几个月来，特朗普政府对中国未能兑现采购美国农产品以及加快出口关键矿产的承诺感到不满，这些关键矿产是制造高科技电子产品和军事装备所必需的。

In a call with Vice Premier He Lifeng of China this month, the Treasury Department said, Mr. Bessent “raised concerns about recent Chinese actions” related to the two nations’ agreement and that “continued progress depends on concrete results.”

美国财政部表示，在本月与中国国务院副总理何立峰的通话中，贝森特就两国协议相关的事宜“对中方近期的行动表达了关切”，并指出“持续进展取决于具体成果”。

3月，黄仁勋展示英伟达芯片。贝森特及政府内的其他官员一直希望更加严厉地限制中国获取先进人工智能算力。

Michael Pillsbury, a China scholar at the right-leaning Heritage Foundation who advised Mr. Trump during his first term, said that Mr. Bessent’s hawkish turn when it comes to technology exports is part of a broader acknowledgment that tariffs and sanctions are not providing the United States with enough economic leverage when dealing with China.

右翼智库传统基金会(Heritage Foundation)的中国问题学者白邦瑞(Michael Pillsbury)曾在第一届特朗普政府任顾问，他表示，贝森特在技术出口问题上的鹰派转向反映出，美国总体上认识到关税和制裁在与中方打交道时并未带来足够多的经济筹码。

“It’s the realization that the original plan or hope with China is not working,” Mr. Pillsbury said, adding that Mr. Bessent was being innovative in the “quest for leverage.”

“人们意识到，原本对华设定的计划或期望并没有奏效，”白邦瑞说，并称贝森特在“寻求筹码”方面正在采取创新做法。

This month, the divide over China policy spilled into public view after Nvidia’s chief executive, Jensen Huang, was revealed to be having an affair with a woman who led a Singaporean data center firm known as Megaspeed. U.S. intelligence believes the woman is a Chinese intelligence asset. The company is under investigation for allegedly smuggling Nvidia chips to China.

本月，在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋被曝与一名领导新加坡数据中心企业Megaspeed的女性存在婚外情后，围绕对华政策的分歧彻底公开化。美国情报部门认为该女子是中国情报线人。该公司正因涉嫌向中国走私英伟达芯片而接受调查。

Megaspeed said in a statement that it conducts legitimate and lawful business, and designs its operations to comply with all laws.

Megaspeed在一份声明中表示，其开展的是正当合法的业务，所有业务运营均严格遵守相关法律法规。

When he was asked last week about the U.S. government’s failure to sanction Megaspeed, Mr. Bessent took the unusual step of declaring that he and other officials had long been pushing for action and placed blame on Mr. Lutnick.

上周，当被问及美国政府为何未能制裁Megaspeed时，贝森特采取了罕见举动，公开表示自己与其他官员长期以来一直在推动采取行动，并将责任归咎于卢特尼克。

“Commerce has the pen,” Mr. Bessent told CNBC. “You will have to ask them about their internal processes.”

“签字笔在商务部手上，”贝森特告诉CNBC。“你们得去问问他们的内部流程。”

On Sunday, Mr. Bessent continued to exert pressure on Nvidia and called on the company to explain itself.

周日，贝森特继续向英伟达施压，并要求该公司作出解释。

“I want to keep coming back to, what was the culture at Nvidia and were they pressing these seemingly illicit sales to goose their revenues and their earnings?” Mr. Bessent told Fox News.

“我想反复追问的是，英伟达的企业文化究竟是怎样的？他们是否在推动这些看似非法的销售，以推高其营收和利润？”贝森特对福克斯新闻表示。

In 2025, Mr. Lutnick rolled out several aggressive measures on U.S. technology exports, which prompted Beijing to take countermeasures that stopped the flow of critical minerals to the United States. He has since taken a more cautious stance and warned that broad rules regulating overseas data centers could upset America’s relationship with China and other countries.

2025年，卢特尼克曾针对美国技术出口推出多项激进措施，促使北京方面采取反制措施，切断了对美国的关键矿产供应。此后，他采取了更为谨慎的立场，并警告称，对海外数据中心实施宽泛的监管规定可能会破坏美国与中国及其他国家的关系。

On Monday, after months of fierce internal debate, the Commerce Department issued a sweeping rule that will crack down on Chinese companies that have been remotely accessing advanced A.I. chips through data centers in Southeast Asia.

周一，经过数月激烈的内部辩论后，商务部发布了一项全面新规，将打击一直通过东南亚数据中心远程访问先进人工智能芯片的中国企业。

Mr. Lutnick had proposed a softer version that would have had less impact on Nvidia, whose chips are used in overseas data centers. But Mr. Bessent and others in the administration wanted a stronger provision that would clamp down on Chinese access to A.I. computing power.

卢特尼克此前曾提议出台一个相对温和的版本，以减小对英伟达的影响，这些海外数据中心使用英伟达芯片。但贝森特及政府内其他官员希望制定更强硬的条款，以限制中方获取人工智能算力。

The Commerce Department, which has authority over the topic, ultimately conceded and published a stronger rule on Monday. But officials drafting the release made clear that it wasn’t their idea.

对这一议题拥有管辖权的商务部最终作出让步，并于周一公布了更为严厉的规定。但起草新闻稿的官员明确表示，这并非他们的主意。

A news release issued by the Commerce Department said that the new rule was “written by and at the direction of the Department of Treasury and the National Security Council” — agencies that have both pushed for more stringent rules.

商务部发布的一份新闻稿称，这项新规“系财政部和国家安全委员会指示并制定”，这两个机构此前均一直推动出台更严格的规定。

Christopher Padilla, a former Commerce Department official in the Bush administration, said he had never seen the agency publicly disavow responsibility for a rule it was publishing and responsible for enforcing. Only the Commerce Department has the technical expertise or legal authority to write such a rule, he said, but the statement made clear that the agency did not want to issue the rule and did so under duress.

布什政府时期的前商务部官员克里斯托弗·帕迪拉表示，他从未见过这个部门公开撇清对其所发布且负责执行的规定的责任。他说，只有商务部拥有制定此类规定的技术专长或法律权限，但声明清楚地表明，商务部并不想发布这项规定，而是在胁迫之下才这么做的。

It’s “like open mutiny,” Mr. Padilla said. “That’s unprecedented, and publicly signals a breakdown of interagency cooperation. Not a great signal to send anytime, but especially on the eve of a summit meeting.”

这“就像一场公开抗命，”帕迪拉说。“这是前所未有的，公开释放出跨部门合作破裂的信号。在任何时候发出这种信号都不太妙，尤其是在峰会前夕。”

Officials have had limited expectations for the China meetings, which are likely to touch on trade, nuclear weapons and the war in Iran.

官员们对此次对华会晤不抱太大希望，会晤预计将涉及贸易、核武器以及伊朗战争等议题。

In a briefing call on Friday night, administration officials said they did not expect to reach an agreement on nuclear nonproliferation at the summit. They said that the focus of meetings with Xi Jinping, the Chinese leader, and other Chinese officials would be implementing a trade agreement between Washington and Beijing. That would include reducing tariffs and other barriers to trade on each side, and ensuring that China was supplying the United States with rare earth minerals.

在周五晚间的一场电话简报会上，政府官员表示，他们预计不会在峰会上就核不扩散问题达成协议。他们表示，与中国领导人习近平及其他中国官员会晤的重点将放在落实华盛顿与北京之间的一项贸易协议上。这将包括削减双方的关税及其他贸易壁垒，以及确保中国向美国供应稀土矿产。

In a speech at the National Committee on U.S.-China Relations gala last week, Mr. Bessent said that he was working with his Chinese counterparts to establish an alert system so that the countries could notify each other of serious incidents involving A.I. models. Despite his more hawkish tone, Mr. Bessent said that he did not want to sever economic ties with China.

上周，贝森特在美中关系全国委员会晚宴上发表演讲时表示，他正与中方对口官员合作建立一套预警机制，以便两国在发生涉及人工智能模型的严重事件时能够相互通报。尽管语调更加鹰派，贝森特表示他并不希望切断与中国的经济联系。

“As we work toward a more balanced relationship, our objective is to de-risk, not to decouple,” Mr. Bessent said.

“在我们努力构建更加平衡的关系之际，我们的目标是去风险，而非脱钩，”贝森特说。

For now, Mr. Trump is not publicly taking sides in the rivalry between Mr. Bessent and Mr. Lutnick.

目前，特朗普尚未在贝森特与卢特尼克的较量中公开选边站队。

“One view is, you don’t want to insult China,” Mr. Trump said on Monday as he departed for his trip. “The other view is, just go down and dirty and do what you have to do. You can’t say either is wrong or right.”

“一种观点认为，你不能得罪中国，”特朗普周一启程出访时说。“另一种观点认为，干脆放手硬碰硬，该怎么做就怎么做。两种观点谈不上谁对谁错。”

He added: “I don’t think you want to insult China just before you get there.”

他还说：“我认为你不应该在去中国之前去得罪它。”

blocks.text: ALAN RAPPEPORT, ANA SWANSON2026年11月17日

President Trump heads to Asia on Monday for high-stakes meetings with foreign leaders aimed at ending Russia’s war in Ukraine and smoothing over trade frictions with China. But the most tense meeting could take place aboard Air Force One.
特朗普总统周一启程前往亚洲，将与外国领导人举行一系列事关重大的会晤，希望结束俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争，并缓和美中贸易摩擦。但最紧张的一场会面可能就发生在“空军一号”上。

Sequestered together on the journey across the world will be Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Howard Lutnick, the commerce secretary, whose long-running rivalry has recently spilled into the open.
在这段跨越大半个地球的行程中，财政部长斯科特·贝森特与商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克将被迫“困”在同一个机舱——两人由来已久的竞争关系近期已公开化。

Mr. Lutnick is under fire for slow-walking several measures aimed at clamping down on the supply of Nvidia chips to foreign data centers that serve Chinese clients. The controversy has put Mr. Lutnick at odds with Mr. Bessent, who has increasingly taken a hard line on China. While Mr. Lutnick has pushed for policies more favorable to Nvidia, Mr. Bessent has played the foil, going so far as to call for a dramatic shake-up of the company’s leadership.
卢特尼克正因拖延多项措施的推进饱受批评，这些措施旨在遏制向服务中国客户的外国数据中心供应英伟达芯片。这一争议使卢特尼克与对华立场日益强硬的贝森特产生了分歧。卢特尼克一直在推动更有利于英伟达的政策，贝森特则扮演了截然相反的角色，甚至呼吁对该公司领导层进行大幅改组。

The Treasury secretary traditionally manages America’s economic relationship with China. After spending much of last year trying to de-escalate tension between the world’s two largest economies over tariffs, Mr. Bessent has taken a more hawkish stance this year amid growing concern over the artificial intelligence race with China and risks that rogue Chinese A.I. technology could pose to the U.S. economy.
传统上，美国对华经济关系由财政部长负责管理。去年大部分时间里，贝森特都在努力缓和全球前两大经济体之间因关税引发的紧张局势；但今年，随着关于中美人工智能竞赛以及中国人工智能技术可能对美国经济构成的风险的担忧日益加剧，他的立场变得更加鹰派。

The internal clash over China policy has echoes of Mr. Trump’s first term, when the president’s economic advisers regularly argued about how forcefully to confront China over its trade practices. After Mr. Trump imposed steep tariffs on Chinese imports last year, Mr. Bessent called for de-escalation and helped broker a trade truce that stabilized the global economy.
围绕对华政策的内部冲突与特朗普第一任期内的情形颇为相似，当时总统的经济顾问们经常争论是否应就中国的贸易行为与其强硬对抗。去年特朗普对中国输美商品加征高额关税后，贝森特曾呼吁局势降温，并协助斡旋达成了一项稳定全球经济的贸易休战协议。

But in recent months, the Trump administration has been frustrated that China has not lived up to its commitments for purchases of American farm products and to accelerate exports of its critical minerals, which are needed for making high-tech electronics and military equipment.
但近几个月来，特朗普政府对中国未能兑现采购美国农产品以及加快出口关键矿产的承诺感到不满，这些关键矿产是制造高科技电子产品和军事装备所必需的。

In a call with Vice Premier He Lifeng of China this month, the Treasury Department said, Mr. Bessent “raised concerns about recent Chinese actions” related to the two nations’ agreement and that “continued progress depends on concrete results.”
美国财政部表示，在本月与中国国务院副总理何立峰的通话中，贝森特就两国协议相关的事宜“对中方近期的行动表达了关切”，并指出“持续进展取决于具体成果”。
3月，黄仁勋展示英伟达芯片。贝森特及政府内的其他官员一直希望更加严厉地限制中国获取先进人工智能算力。

Michael Pillsbury, a China scholar at the right-leaning Heritage Foundation who advised Mr. Trump during his first term, said that Mr. Bessent’s hawkish turn when it comes to technology exports is part of a broader acknowledgment that tariffs and sanctions are not providing the United States with enough economic leverage when dealing with China.
右翼智库传统基金会(Heritage Foundation)的中国问题学者白邦瑞(Michael Pillsbury)曾在第一届特朗普政府任顾问，他表示，贝森特在技术出口问题上的鹰派转向反映出，美国总体上认识到关税和制裁在与中方打交道时并未带来足够多的经济筹码。
“It’s the realization that the original plan or hope with China is not working,” Mr. Pillsbury said, adding that Mr. Bessent was being innovative in the “quest for leverage.”
“人们意识到，原本对华设定的计划或期望并没有奏效，”白邦瑞说，并称贝森特在“寻求筹码”方面正在采取创新做法。

This month, the divide over China policy spilled into public view after Nvidia’s chief executive, Jensen Huang, was revealed to be having an affair with a woman who led a Singaporean data center firm known as Megaspeed. U.S. intelligence believes the woman is a Chinese intelligence asset. The company is under investigation for allegedly smuggling Nvidia chips to China.
本月，在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋被曝与一名领导新加坡数据中心企业Megaspeed的女性存在婚外情后，围绕对华政策的分歧彻底公开化。美国情报部门认为该女子是中国情报线人。该公司正因涉嫌向中国走私英伟达芯片而接受调查。
Megaspeed said in a statement that it conducts legitimate and lawful business, and designs its operations to comply with all laws.
Megaspeed在一份声明中表示，其开展的是正当合法的业务，所有业务运营均严格遵守相关法律法规。

When he was asked last week about the U.S. government’s failure to sanction Megaspeed, Mr. Bessent took the unusual step of declaring that he and other officials had long been pushing for action and placed blame on Mr. Lutnick.
上周，当被问及美国政府为何未能制裁Megaspeed时，贝森特采取了罕见举动，公开表示自己与其他官员长期以来一直在推动采取行动，并将责任归咎于卢特尼克。
“Commerce has the pen,” Mr. Bessent told CNBC. “You will have to ask them about their internal processes.”
“签字笔在商务部手上，”贝森特告诉CNBC。“你们得去问问他们的内部流程。”
On Sunday, Mr. Bessent continued to exert pressure on Nvidia and called on the company to explain itself.
周日，贝森特继续向英伟达施压，并要求该公司作出解释。
“I want to keep coming back to, what was the culture at Nvidia and were they pressing these seemingly illicit sales to goose their revenues and their earnings?” Mr. Bessent told Fox News.
“我想反复追问的是，英伟达的企业文化究竟是怎样的？他们是否在推动这些看似非法的销售，以推高其营收和利润？”贝森特对福克斯新闻表示。

In 2025, Mr. Lutnick rolled out several aggressive measures on U.S. technology exports, which prompted Beijing to take countermeasures that stopped the flow of critical minerals to the United States. He has since taken a more cautious stance and warned that broad rules regulating overseas data centers could upset America’s relationship with China and other countries.
2025年，卢特尼克曾针对美国技术出口推出多项激进措施，促使北京方面采取反制措施，切断了对美国的关键矿产供应。此后，他采取了更为谨慎的立场，并警告称，对海外数据中心实施宽泛的监管规定可能会破坏美国与中国及其他国家的关系。

On Monday, after months of fierce internal debate, the Commerce Department issued a sweeping rule that will crack down on Chinese companies that have been remotely accessing advanced A.I. chips through data centers in Southeast Asia.
周一，经过数月激烈的内部辩论后，商务部发布了一项全面新规，将打击一直通过东南亚数据中心远程访问先进人工智能芯片的中国企业。

Mr. Lutnick had proposed a softer version that would have had less impact on Nvidia, whose chips are used in overseas data centers. But Mr. Bessent and others in the administration wanted a stronger provision that would clamp down on Chinese access to A.I. computing power.
卢特尼克此前曾提议出台一个相对温和的版本，以减小对英伟达的影响，这些海外数据中心使用英伟达芯片。但贝森特及政府内其他官员希望制定更强硬的条款，以限制中方获取人工智能算力。
The Commerce Department, which has authority over the topic, ultimately conceded and published a stronger rule on Monday. But officials drafting the release made clear that it wasn’t their idea.
对这一议题拥有管辖权的商务部最终作出让步，并于周一公布了更为严厉的规定。但起草新闻稿的官员明确表示，这并非他们的主意。

A news release issued by the Commerce Department said that the new rule was “written by and at the direction of the Department of Treasury and the National Security Council” — agencies that have both pushed for more stringent rules.
商务部发布的一份新闻稿称，这项新规“系财政部和国家安全委员会指示并制定”，这两个机构此前均一直推动出台更严格的规定。

Christopher Padilla, a former Commerce Department official in the Bush administration, said he had never seen the agency publicly disavow responsibility for a rule it was publishing and responsible for enforcing. Only the Commerce Department has the technical expertise or legal authority to write such a rule, he said, but the statement made clear that the agency did not want to issue the rule and did so under duress.
布什政府时期的前商务部官员克里斯托弗·帕迪拉表示，他从未见过这个部门公开撇清对其所发布且负责执行的规定的责任。他说，只有商务部拥有制定此类规定的技术专长或法律权限，但声明清楚地表明，商务部并不想发布这项规定，而是在胁迫之下才这么做的。

It’s “like open mutiny,” Mr. Padilla said. “That’s unprecedented, and publicly signals a breakdown of interagency cooperation. Not a great signal to send anytime, but especially on the eve of a summit meeting.”
这“就像一场公开抗命，”帕迪拉说。“这是前所未有的，公开释放出跨部门合作破裂的信号。在任何时候发出这种信号都不太妙，尤其是在峰会前夕。”
Officials have had limited expectations for the China meetings, which are likely to touch on trade, nuclear weapons and the war in Iran.
官员们对此次对华会晤不抱太大希望，会晤预计将涉及贸易、核武器以及伊朗战争等议题。

In a briefing call on Friday night, administration officials said they did not expect to reach an agreement on nuclear nonproliferation at the summit. They said that the focus of meetings with Xi Jinping, the Chinese leader, and other Chinese officials would be implementing a trade agreement between Washington and Beijing. That would include reducing tariffs and other barriers to trade on each side, and ensuring that China was supplying the United States with rare earth minerals.
在周五晚间的一场电话简报会上，政府官员表示，他们预计不会在峰会上就核不扩散问题达成协议。他们表示，与中国领导人习近平及其他中国官员会晤的重点将放在落实华盛顿与北京之间的一项贸易协议上。这将包括削减双方的关税及其他贸易壁垒，以及确保中国向美国供应稀土矿产。

In a speech at the National Committee on U.S.-China Relations gala last week, Mr. Bessent said that he was working with his Chinese counterparts to establish an alert system so that the countries could notify each other of serious incidents involving A.I. models. Despite his more hawkish tone, Mr. Bessent said that he did not want to sever economic ties with China.
上周，贝森特在美中关系全国委员会晚宴上发表演讲时表示，他正与中方对口官员合作建立一套预警机制，以便两国在发生涉及人工智能模型的严重事件时能够相互通报。尽管语调更加鹰派，贝森特表示他并不希望切断与中国的经济联系。
“As we work toward a more balanced relationship, our objective is to de-risk, not to decouple,” Mr. Bessent said.
“在我们努力构建更加平衡的关系之际，我们的目标是去风险，而非脱钩，”贝森特说。
For now, Mr. Trump is not publicly taking sides in the rivalry between Mr. Bessent and Mr. Lutnick.
目前，特朗普尚未在贝森特与卢特尼克的较量中公开选边站队。

“One view is, you don’t want to insult China,” Mr. Trump said on Monday as he departed for his trip. “The other view is, just go down and dirty and do what you have to do. You can’t say either is wrong or right.”
“一种观点认为，你不能得罪中国，”特朗普周一启程出访时说。“另一种观点认为，干脆放手硬碰硬，该怎么做就怎么做。两种观点谈不上谁对谁错。”
He added: “I don’t think you want to insult China just before you get there.”
他还说：“我认为你不应该在去中国之前去得罪它。”

DAMIEN CAVE2026年11月17日

周一，各国领导人在马尼拉举行的东盟峰会上合影。 Pool photo by Ted Aljibe

President Trump’s trip to Asia this week will largely be seen as a test of American power in the main region where the United States and China compete for influence.

亚洲是美国与中国争夺影响力的主要地区。特朗普总统本周的亚洲之行在很大程度上将被视为对美国实力的一次考验。

His meetings in Manila and Shenzhen, China, will be scrutinized for shifts on trade and security. Deals he might strike with Beijing — plus a gathering with President Xi Jinping of China and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia — will put the world’s great-power contest on display, as all three seek to show strength.

外界将密切关注特朗普在马尼拉和中国深圳举行的会晤，从中寻找贸易和安全政策可能出现变化的迹象。他可能与北京达成的协议、他与习近平和普京举行的三方会晤都将成为世界大国角力的舞台。三位领导人都希望借此展示自己的实力。

But Asia is not just a theater of competition. Many countries in the region have become wealthier, more technologically advanced and increasingly interconnected. Especially now, as China’s military becomes more threatening and the United States less reliable, they are hedging against greatness and relying more on neighbors.

但亚洲并不仅仅是大国竞争的舞台。该地区许多国家变得更加富裕，技术更加先进，彼此之间的联系也日益紧密。尤其是在中国的军事力量构成越来越大威胁、美国越来越不可靠的当下，这些国家正努力减少对大国的依赖，更多地寻求邻国的支持。

Asian students and workers are moving to neighboring states. Countries with expanding defense industries are selling weapons to new partners. Nations that compete for high-tech investment are even making plans to cooperate on energy and cybersecurity.

亚洲的学生和劳动力正在向邻近国家流动。国防工业不断扩张的国家开始向新的合作伙伴出售武器。那些相互争夺高科技投资的国家甚至在制定能源和网络安全合作计划。

“They’re all looking at what more they can do together when the great powers are behaving so badly,” said Ted Osius, a former U.S. ambassador to Vietnam and adjunct professor of geopolitics at Fulbright University in Ho Chi Minh City. “If you’re a middle power, you’re thinking ‘I need more options.’”

“当大国表现得如此糟糕时，这些国家都在思考还能通过合作做些什么，”前美国驻越南大使、胡志明市富布赖特大学地缘政治学兼职教授泰德·奥修斯说。“如果你是一个中等强国，你就会想：‘我需要更多选择。’”

Here are a few numbers that provide a sense of what the region contributes to the global economy, and how its nations are becoming more bound together to shape the world.

以下一些数字可让人了解该地区对全球经济的贡献，以及该地区各国如何通过日益紧密的联系，共同塑造世界。

700 million …

7亿

The population of the 11 nations that make up the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, a regional grouping that is holding its annual summit in Manila. ASEAN approved a digital framework agreement on Saturday that aims to create a multilateral digital market. If it rolls out smoothly next year, a small business in Vietnam could sell and ship products to Singapore with invoices, payment and customs handled through a regional online system.

这是东盟11个成员国的总人口。这是一个区域性组织，目前正在马尼拉举行年度峰会。东盟上周六批准了一项旨在建立多边数字市场的数字经济框架协议。如果明年顺利实施，越南的一家小企业就可以通过区域性在线系统完成开具发票、支付和清关等手续，将商品销售并运往新加坡。

$70.77 billion …

707.7亿美元

The value of the Asia-Pacific market for medical tourism — the world’s largest. With portable insurance and medical visas, it’s becoming common to travel for better or more affordable cancer care, orthopedics, dentistry or cosmetic surgery. Life expectancy in high-income countries (like Japan) is around 84, compared with 79.8 in the United States, where health care costs are roughly twice as high.

这是亚太地区医疗旅游市场的规模，也是全球最大的医疗旅游市场。随着跨境适用的医疗保险和医疗签证日益普及，为了获得更好的医疗服务或降低费用，人们前往其他国家接受癌症治疗、骨科治疗、牙科治疗或整容手术的情况越来越普遍。日本等高收入国家的预期寿命约为84岁，而美国为79.8岁，医疗费用却大约高出一倍。

75 percent …

75%

The share of the world’s semiconductor chips that are manufactured in Asia. Without China, about 55 to 60 percent are made in Asia, led by South Korea and Taiwan, which makes more than 90 percent of the world’s high-end chips. The global market is worth roughly $1.5 trillion.

这是亚洲生产的半导体芯片占全球总量的份额。如果不计中国，亚洲仍生产全球约55%至60%的芯片，其中韩国和台湾占据主导地位。台湾生产了全球90%以上的高端芯片。全球半导体市场规模约为1.5万亿美元。

6 out of 10 …

6/10

The number of top-grossing musical acts in Asia that were K-pop performers from August 2025 to July 2026. The top four earners for live shows in Asia were all K-pop stars, with Seventeen topping the list. Lady Gaga ranked fifth in the region.

2025年8月至2026年7月，亚洲的音乐人巡演收入排行榜前十中K-pop组合占据六席。排名前四的全是K-pop组合，其中Seventeen位居榜首，Lady Gaga排名第五。

33 …

33所

The number of universities in the Asia-Pacific region in the QS global top 100. Among them are 11 in mainland China and Hong Kong, plus nine in Australia. There are 37 in Europe and 26 in the United States.

这是亚太地区进入QS世界大学排名前100名的大学数量。其中中国大陆和香港共有11所，澳大利亚有九所。而欧洲有37所，美国有26所。

1.7 billion …

17亿人次

The number of airline passenger journeys across the Asia-Pacific, excluding China, in 2024. Driven by booming demand in India and Southeast Asia, regional traffic is projected to more than double to 4.1 billion passengers over the next two decades.

这是2024年亚太地区（不含中国）的航空旅客运输量。在印度和东南亚需求激增的推动下，预计未来20年，该地区的航空客运量将增长一倍以上，达到41亿人次。

$630 million …

6.3亿美元

The approximate cost of Indonesia’s recent deal to buy India’s BrahMos supersonic missile systems for coastal defense. India has inked similar deals with Vietnam and the Philippines, as the region seeks alternatives to expensive Western weapons systems.

印尼最近购买印度布拉莫斯超音速导弹系统用于海岸防御的大致费用。印度已与越南和菲律宾签署类似协议，该地区各国正寻求昂贵的西方武器系统之外的其他选择。

2,499 …

2499家

The total number of Uniqlo stores worldwide, up from 1,795 in 2016. Even as its retail footprint in China has declined, growth in Southeast Asia, India and Australia has continued. The Japanese fashion brand is now one of the world’s fastest growing clothing retailers.

这是优衣库在全球的门店总数，高于2016年的1795家。尽管优衣库在中国的门店数量有所减少，但在东南亚、印度和澳大利亚仍在持续扩张。如今，这个日本时装品牌已成为全球增长最快的服装零售商之一。

3.65 million …

365万人次

The number of Japanese visits to South Korea in 2025 — a record for two countries that have been gradually overcoming a long history of resentment. The curiosity goes both ways: Koreans also set a record for trips to Japan last year, with 9.46 million visits.

2025年日本人赴韩国旅行人次创下历史纪录。两国长期以来积怨颇深，但近年来正逐步化解历史恩怨。两国民众对彼此的兴趣是双向的：去年，韩国人赴日旅行也创下纪录，达到946万人次。

18 …

18个

The number of cross-border energy projects planned among ASEAN countries. With high-voltage lines on land and plans for some of the longest power cables ever to be placed underwater, the goal is to more than double transmission capacity and to pave the way for a multilateral power market that is more reliant on renewable energy, like hydropower.

President Trump’s trip to Asia this week will largely be seen as a test of American power in the main region where the United States and China compete for influence.

Putin of Russia — will put the world’s great-power contest on display, as all three seek to show strength.

$70.77 billion …

The value of the Asia-Pacific market for medical tourism — the world’s largest. With portable insurance and medical visas, it’s becoming common to travel for better or more affordable cancer care, orthopedics, dentistry or cosmetic surgery. Life expectancy in high-income countries (like Japan) is around 84, compared with 79.8 in the United States, where health care costs are roughly twice as high.
这是亚太地区医疗旅游市场的规模，也是全球最大的医疗旅游市场。随着跨境适用的医疗保险和医疗签证日益普及，为了获得更好的医疗服务或降低费用，人们前往其他国家接受癌症治疗、骨科治疗、牙科治疗或整容手术的情况越来越普遍。日本等高收入国家的预期寿命约为84岁，而美国为79.8岁，医疗费用却大约高出一倍。

17亿人次

The number of airline passenger journeys across the Asia-Pacific, excluding China, in 2024. Driven by booming demand in India and Southeast Asia, regional traffic is projected to more than double to 4.1 billion passengers over the next two decades.

MIRA RAPP-HOOPER, ELY RATNER2026年11月17日

Damon Winter/The New York Times

Since returning to the White House, President Trump has gambled that if Washington took a more accommodating stance toward China’s ambitions in Asia, Beijing would respond with restraint.

自重返白宫以来，特朗普总统一直抱着这样一种侥幸心理：如果华盛顿对中国在亚洲的野心采取更包容的立场，北京方面就会以克制作为回应。

The Trump administration has scaled back key military operations in the region and withheld support for Taiwan and U.S. allies facing Chinese coercion. The hope has been that such measures would help avert a potential clash with China. But nearly two years into his second term, Mr. Trump’s approach is backfiring, emboldening China to throw its weight around Asia and raising the risk of a military crisis.

特朗普政府缩减了在亚太地区的关键军事行动，并对面临中国胁迫的台湾及其他美国盟友拒绝提供支持。其初衷是，此类举措将有助于避免与中国发生潜在冲突。但第二任期已近两年，特朗普的做法正在适得其反，不仅让中国在亚洲更加肆无忌惮，还增加了爆发军事危机的风险。

The Democratic victory in the U.S. midterm elections offers a critical opportunity for change. With control of both chambers of Congress, Democrats will have the power to put guardrails around the president’s failing China policy — and they may not have to do it alone.

民主党在美国中期选举中的胜利为改变现状提供了关键契机。凭借对国会两院的控制权，民主党人将有能力为总统失败的对华政策设置护栏，而且他们或许不必孤军奋战。

For years, Republicans in Congress were among the strongest voices for standing up to Beijing, yet many have stayed quiet to avoid challenging the president. The unmistakable rebuke that voters delivered to Mr. Trump this month may change that calculus by giving Republicans more leeway to work with Democrats toward a course correction on China.

多年来，国会共和党人一直是主张对抗北京的最强烈声音之一，然而为了避免挑战总统，许多人保持了沉默。选民本月对特朗普发出的明确斥责可能会改变这一考量，让共和党人有更多与民主党人合作以纠正对华路线的余地。

The new Congress must move quickly to assert its constitutional power over spending, oversight and confirmation of presidential appointments to limit the damage the administration can do in its final two years and build an approach to Asia that allies can count on and that Beijing has to take seriously.

新一届国会必须迅速采取行动，行使宪法赋予其在支出、监督和总统任命确认方面的权力，以限制政府在最后两年任期内可能造成的破坏，并制定出一套让盟友能够依赖、也让北京必须认真对待的亚洲政策。

Breaking with past administrations, the president has played down the notion of strategic competition with China in favor of what both Beijing and Washington now describe as a “constructive relationship of strategic stability.” That shift will frame the conversation during a series of summits in Asia that Mr. Trump will attend this week, including a meeting of Southeast Asian leaders in Manila, followed by a wider Asia-Pacific gathering in China where he is expected to meet President Xi Jinping for the third time this year.

与历届政府不同，总统淡化了对华战略竞争的概念，转而支持目前北京与华盛顿双方都称为“建设性战略稳定关系”的主张。这一转变将为本周特朗普出席的亚洲一系列峰会定下基调，其中包括在马尼拉举行的东南亚领导人会议，以及随后在中国举行的一场更广泛的亚太地区会议——预计他将在会上与习近平主席进行今年的第三次会晤。

China’s leaders have long made clear that they want the United States to keep its warships away from China’s coast, end arms sales to Taiwan, leave Beijing’s expansive maritime claims unchallenged, pull American forces from the region and refrain from siding with allies who cross China.

中国领导人长期以来一直明确表示，希望美国军舰远离中国海岸，停止对台军售，不对北京广泛的海洋主张提出挑战，从该地区撤出美国军队，并避免与触怒中国的盟友站在一起。

Over the past two years, the Trump administration has granted much of that.

过去两年中，特朗普政府满足了其中的大部分要求。

It has canceled or downgraded defense talks with Taiwan and is holding up a $14 billion arms package for the island. The U.S. Navy is on track to make only half as many publicly announced transits through the Taiwan Strait as it did during Mr. Trump’s first term and has reported fewer freedom of navigation patrols in the South China Sea — activities that have long been important in signaling America’s commitment to regional security and challenging China’s spurious maritime claims. Mr. Trump’s open-ended war with Iran also has played into Beijing’s hands by drawing U.S. missile defenses, Marines and aircraft carriers out of the Indo-Pacific region to support the Middle East conflict.

政府取消或降级了与台湾的防务会谈，并搁置了对该岛价值140亿美元的武器援助计划。美国海军目前公开宣布穿越台湾海峡的次数仅为特朗普第一任期内的一半，其报告在南海进行的“航行自由”巡逻次数也有所减少——长期以来，这些活动一直是展示美国对地区安全承诺以及挑战中国站不住脚的海洋主张的重要信号。特朗普与伊朗之间无休止的战争也正中北京下怀，这场冲突将美国的导弹防御系统、海军陆战队和航空母舰调离了印太地区，以支援中东冲突。

The White House seems to believe that keeping tensions with China in check will buy time for America to reduce its dependence on Chinese rare earths, rebuild the U.S. defense industrial base and manage the war with Iran.

白宫似乎相信，控制与中国的紧张局势将为美国赢得时间，以减少对中国稀土的依赖、重建美国国防工业基础，并应对与伊朗的战争。

Yet Beijing has continued to press its advantage.

然而，北京方面继续乘势施压。

Last November, China launched a campaign of economic pressure against Japan after Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi suggested her country might intervene in a conflict over Taiwan. In December, China deployed more than 100 naval and coast guard vessels in East Asian waters in a show of force, with Chinese fighters twice locking their targeting radar on Japanese aircraft. That same month, China conducted live-fire military drills closer to Taiwan than ever before, simulating a blockade of the island’s major ports. It has expanded its presence on disputed islands and reefs in the South China Sea and in late September unveiled a new defense outpost in Laos.

去年11月，在日本首相高市早苗暗示可能介入因台湾而起的冲突后，中国对日本发起了一场经济施压运动。去年12月，中国在东亚水域部署了100多艘海军和海警舰艇以展示武力，期间中国战斗机两次使用火控雷达锁定日本军机。同月，中国在有史以来最靠近台湾的地方举行了实弹军事演习，模拟封锁该岛的主要港口。中国在南海扩大了在争议岛屿和岛礁上的存在，并于9月底在老挝设立了一处新的防务前哨基地。

Past U.S. presidential administrations forcefully challenged Beijing over such encroachments, opposing China’s militarization of the South China Sea, standing by allies under coercion and working to block China’s push for military bases abroad.

美国历届政府都曾对此类进犯行为向北京发起过强有力的挑战，反对中国在南海的军事化，坚守在受胁迫的盟友身边，并努力阻止中国在海外建立军事基地的图谋。

The Trump administration, on the other hand, has largely stood by. The ill-conceived conflict with Iran has left Americans understandably weary of war, and pulling back from Asia may be tempting. But each time Washington stands aside while Beijing presses an ally, China has more reason to believe it can go further, raising the odds that it will cross a line Washington cannot ignore. And as China’s military acts more aggressively, a single accident at sea or in the air could spark a crisis.

特朗普政府则在很大程度上袖手旁观。与伊朗这场考虑不周的冲突已让美国人对战争产生合理的厌倦，因此从亚洲抽身可能颇具诱惑力。但是，每当北京向盟友施压而华盛顿作壁上观时，中国就有更多理由相信自己可以得寸进尺，从而增加了其跨越华盛顿无法忽视的底线的几率。此外，随着中国军队的行动日益强势，海上或空中的单一意外事件就可能引发一场危机。

U.S. presidents retain broad latitude over foreign policy. But Congress’s armed services and foreign affairs committees should hold hearings as soon as possible to press the administration to proceed with the Taiwan arms package and return U.S. forces to Asia from the Middle East. If the administration stonewalls, Congress can hold up spending on other White House priorities. In budget negotiations, lawmakers should lock in more security assistance for Asian partners and accelerate much-needed upgrades to bases in Japan and the Philippines that U.S. forces would rely on in a conflict.

美国总统在外交政策上保留着广泛的自由裁量权。但国会军事和外交事务委员会应尽快举行听证会，敦促政府推进对台武器援助计划，并将美军从中东调回亚洲。如果政府拖延阻挠，国会可以搁置白宫其他优先事项的支出。在预算谈判中，立法者应锁定更多对亚洲伙伴的安全援助，并加快对日本和菲律宾诸多美军在冲突中依赖的基地进行亟需的升级。

The Senate also can make confirmation of pending and future appointments to the Pentagon and State Department contingent on a commitment to restoring regular U.S. Navy transits of key waterways in the region and supporting allies facing Chinese intimidation. In next year’s annual defense bill, Congress should commit more money to the Pacific Deterrence Initiative, a program it established in 2021 to strengthen America’s military position in the region but which came with no dedicated funding.

参议院还可以要求政府承诺恢复美国海军在地区关键水道的定期航行，并支持面临中国恐吓的盟友，以此作为五角大楼和国务院当前及未来任命确认的先决条件。在明年的年度国防法案中，国会应向“太平洋威慑倡议”(Pacific Deterrence Initiative)投入更多资金，国会于2021年设立了这一项目以加强美国在亚太地区的军事地位，但当时并未拨付专项资金。

A bipartisan approach is more likely to succeed and endure. Leading Democratic and Republican members of Congress have already called on Mr. Trump to release the stalled Taiwan arms package.

两党合作的方法更有可能取得成功并持久有效。国会两党的主要领导人已经呼吁特朗普启动被搁置的对台武器援助计划。

The midterms offer a chance to go further in restoring America’s commitment to its allies in Asia and rebuilding an approach to the region that actually keeps the peace.

中期选举提供了一个机会，可以在恢复美国对亚洲盟友的承诺，以及重建一种真正能够维护地区和平的政策。

Mira Rapp-Hooper是布鲁金斯学会的访问高级研究员。她此前曾担任美国国家安全委员会总统特别助理兼东亚和大洋洲高级主任。

Ely Ratner是马拉松倡议组织的负责人。他此前曾担任负责印太安全事务的国防部助理部长。

Damon Winter/The New York Times
Since returning to the White House, President Trump has gambled that if Washington took a more accommodating stance toward China’s ambitions in Asia, Beijing would respond with restraint.
自重返白宫以来，特朗普总统一直抱着这样一种侥幸心理：如果华盛顿对中国在亚洲的野心采取更包容的立场，北京方面就会以克制作为回应。

The Trump administration has scaled back key military operations in the region and withheld support for Taiwan and U.S. allies facing Chinese coercion. The hope has been that such measures would help avert a potential clash with China. But nearly two years into his second term, Mr. Trump’s approach is backfiring, emboldening China to throw its weight around Asia and raising the risk of a military crisis.
特朗普政府缩减了在亚太地区的关键军事行动，并对面临中国胁迫的台湾及其他美国盟友拒绝提供支持。其初衷是，此类举措将有助于避免与中国发生潜在冲突。但第二任期已近两年，特朗普的做法正在适得其反，不仅让中国在亚洲更加肆无忌惮，还增加了爆发军事危机的风险。

The Democratic victory in the U.S. midterm elections offers a critical opportunity for change. With control of both chambers of Congress, Democrats will have the power to put guardrails around the president’s failing China policy — and they may not have to do it alone.
民主党在美国中期选举中的胜利为改变现状提供了关键契机。凭借对国会两院的控制权，民主党人将有能力为总统失败的对华政策设置护栏，而且他们或许不必孤军奋战。

For years, Republicans in Congress were among the strongest voices for standing up to Beijing, yet many have stayed quiet to avoid challenging the president. The unmistakable rebuke that voters delivered to Mr. Trump this month may change that calculus by giving Republicans more leeway to work with Democrats toward a course correction on China.
多年来，国会共和党人一直是主张对抗北京的最强烈声音之一，然而为了避免挑战总统，许多人保持了沉默。选民本月对特朗普发出的明确斥责可能会改变这一考量，让共和党人有更多与民主党人合作以纠正对华路线的余地。

The new Congress must move quickly to assert its constitutional power over spending, oversight and confirmation of presidential appointments to limit the damage the administration can do in its final two years and build an approach to Asia that allies can count on and that Beijing has to take seriously.
新一届国会必须迅速采取行动，行使宪法赋予其在支出、监督和总统任命确认方面的权力，以限制政府在最后两年任期内可能造成的破坏，并制定出一套让盟友能够依赖、也让北京必须认真对待的亚洲政策。

Breaking with past administrations, the president has played down the notion of strategic competition with China in favor of what both Beijing and Washington now describe as a “constructive relationship of strategic stability.” That shift will frame the conversation during a series of summits in Asia that Mr. Trump will attend this week, including a meeting of Southeast Asian leaders in Manila, followed by a wider Asia-Pacific gathering in China where he is expected to meet President Xi Jinping for the third time this year.
与历届政府不同，总统淡化了对华战略竞争的概念，转而支持目前北京与华盛顿双方都称为“建设性战略稳定关系”的主张。这一转变将为本周特朗普出席的亚洲一系列峰会定下基调，其中包括在马尼拉举行的东南亚领导人会议，以及随后在中国举行的一场更广泛的亚太地区会议——预计他将在会上与习近平主席进行今年的第三次会晤。

China’s leaders have long made clear that they want the United States to keep its warships away from China’s coast, end arms sales to Taiwan, leave Beijing’s expansive maritime claims unchallenged, pull American forces from the region and refrain from siding with allies who cross China.
中国领导人长期以来一直明确表示，希望美国军舰远离中国海岸，停止对台军售，不对北京广泛的海洋主张提出挑战，从该地区撤出美国军队，并避免与触怒中国的盟友站在一起。
Over the past two years, the Trump administration has granted much of that.
过去两年中，特朗普政府满足了其中的大部分要求。

It has canceled or downgraded defense talks with Taiwan and is holding up a $14 billion arms package for the island. The U.S. Navy is on track to make only half as many publicly announced transits through the Taiwan Strait as it did during Mr. Trump’s first term and has reported fewer freedom of navigation patrols in the South China Sea — activities that have long been important in signaling America’s commitment to regional security and challenging China’s spurious maritime claims. Mr. Trump’s open-ended war with Iran also has played into Beijing’s hands by drawing U.S. missile defenses, Marines and aircraft carriers out of the Indo-Pacific region to support the Middle East conflict.

政府取消或降级了与台湾的防务会谈，并搁置了对该岛价值140亿美元的武器援助计划。美国海军目前公开宣布穿越台湾海峡的次数仅为特朗普第一任期内的一半，其报告在南海进行的“航行自由”巡逻次数也有所减少——长期以来，这些活动一直是展示美国对地区安全承诺以及挑战中国站不住脚的海洋主张的重要信号。特朗普与伊朗之间无休止的战争也正中北京下怀，这场冲突将美国的导弹防御系统、海军陆战队和航空母舰调离了印太地区，以支援中东冲突。

The White House seems to believe that keeping tensions with China in check will buy time for America to reduce its dependence on Chinese rare earths, rebuild the U.S. defense industrial base and manage the war with Iran.
白宫似乎相信，控制与中国的紧张局势将为美国赢得时间，以减少对中国稀土的依赖、重建美国国防工业基础，并应对与伊朗的战争。
Yet Beijing has continued to press its advantage.
然而，北京方面继续乘势施压。

Last November, China launched a campaign of economic pressure against Japan after Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi suggested her country might intervene in a conflict over Taiwan. In December, China deployed more than 100 naval and coast guard vessels in East Asian waters in a show of force, with Chinese fighters twice locking their targeting radar on Japanese aircraft. That same month, China conducted live-fire military drills closer to Taiwan than ever before, simulating a blockade of the island’s major ports. It has expanded its presence on disputed islands and reefs in the South China Sea and in late September unveiled a new defense outpost in Laos.
去年11月，在日本首相高市早苗暗示可能介入因台湾而起的冲突后，中国对日本发起了一场经济施压运动。去年12月，中国在东亚水域部署了100多艘海军和海警舰艇以展示武力，期间中国战斗机两次使用火控雷达锁定日本军机。同月，中国在有史以来最靠近台湾的地方举行了实弹军事演习，模拟封锁该岛的主要港口。中国在南海扩大了在争议岛屿和岛礁上的存在，并于9月底在老挝设立了一处新的防务前哨基地。

Past U.S. presidential administrations forcefully challenged Beijing over such encroachments, opposing China’s militarization of the South China Sea, standing by allies under coercion and working to block China’s push for military bases abroad.
美国历届政府都曾对此类进犯行为向北京发起过强有力的挑战，反对中国在南海的军事化，坚守在受胁迫的盟友身边，并努力阻止中国在海外建立军事基地的图谋。

The Trump administration, on the other hand, has largely stood by. The ill-conceived conflict with Iran has left Americans understandably weary of war, and pulling back from Asia may be tempting. But each time Washington stands aside while Beijing presses an ally, China has more reason to believe it can go further, raising the odds that it will cross a line Washington cannot ignore. And as China’s military acts more aggressively, a single accident at sea or in the air could spark a crisis.
特朗普政府则在很大程度上袖手旁观。与伊朗这场考虑不周的冲突已让美国人对战争产生合理的厌倦，因此从亚洲抽身可能颇具诱惑力。但是，每当北京向盟友施压而华盛顿作壁上观时，中国就有更多理由相信自己可以得寸进尺，从而增加了其跨越华盛顿无法忽视的底线的几率。此外，随着中国军队的行动日益强势，海上或空中的单一意外事件就可能引发一场危机。

U.S. presidents retain broad latitude over foreign policy. But Congress’s armed services and foreign affairs committees should hold hearings as soon as possible to press the administration to proceed with the Taiwan arms package and return U.S. forces to Asia from the Middle East. If the administration stonewalls, Congress can hold up spending on other White House priorities. In budget negotiations, lawmakers should lock in more security assistance for Asian partners and accelerate much-needed upgrades to bases in Japan and the Philippines that U.S. forces would rely on in a conflict.
美国总统在外交政策上保留着广泛的自由裁量权。但国会军事和外交事务委员会应尽快举行听证会，敦促政府推进对台武器援助计划，并将美军从中东调回亚洲。如果政府拖延阻挠，国会可以搁置白宫其他优先事项的支出。在预算谈判中，立法者应锁定更多对亚洲伙伴的安全援助，并加快对日本和菲律宾诸多美军在冲突中依赖的基地进行亟需的升级。

The Senate also can make confirmation of pending and future appointments to the Pentagon and State Department contingent on a commitment to restoring regular U.S. Navy transits of key waterways in the region and supporting allies facing Chinese intimidation. In next year’s annual defense bill, Congress should commit more money to the Pacific Deterrence Initiative, a program it established in 2021 to strengthen America’s military position in the region but which came with no dedicated funding.
参议院还可以要求政府承诺恢复美国海军在地区关键水道的定期航行，并支持面临中国恐吓的盟友，以此作为五角大楼和国务院当前及未来任命确认的先决条件。在明年的年度国防法案中，国会应向“太平洋威慑倡议”(Pacific Deterrence Initiative)投入更多资金，国会于2021年设立了这一项目以加强美国在亚太地区的军事地位，但当时并未拨付专项资金。
A bipartisan approach is more likely to succeed and endure. Leading Democratic and Republican members of Congress have already called on Mr. Trump to release the stalled Taiwan arms package.
两党合作的方法更有可能取得成功并持久有效。国会两党的主要领导人已经呼吁特朗普启动被搁置的对台武器援助计划。
The midterms offer a chance to go further in restoring America’s commitment to its allies in Asia and rebuilding an approach to the region that actually keeps the peace.
中期选举提供了一个机会，可以在恢复美国对亚洲盟友的承诺，以及重建一种真正能够维护地区和平的政策。
Mira Rapp-Hooper是布鲁金斯学会的访问高级研究员。她此前曾担任美国国家安全委员会总统特别助理兼东亚和大洋洲高级主任。
Ely Ratner是马拉松倡议组织的负责人。他此前曾担任负责印太安全事务的国防部助理部长。

日本天皇长女爱子飞赴新加坡 开启第二次正式外访

日本天皇夫妇长女爱子17日搭乘民航客机从东京羽田机场启程，开启对新加坡的正式访问。今年正值两国建交60周年。爱子将在新加坡逗留至21日，其间她将礼节性拜访新加坡总统尚达曼并出席其主办的午餐会等活动，以期增进两国友好。这是继去年到访老挝之后，爱子第二次进行正式外访。

爱子将于17日下午抵达樟宜国际机场。在新加坡逗留期间她还将出席新加坡植物园的兰花命名仪式以及日式庭园“星和园”的植树仪式。新加坡是多民族国家，爱子将参观提供各种民族美食的集市摊位并前往新加坡著名地标鱼尾狮公园。此外还计划与当地日侨进行交流。

这是2006年在位期间的上皇夫妇作为国宾受邀以来，日本皇室再次对该国进行正式访问。爱子去年5月曾在大阪·关西世博会上参观新加坡馆。

items.body:
香港迪士尼乐园约1.7万个电子门票二维码疑被盗取

香港迪士尼乐园的在线票务系统遭到入侵，据香港媒体报道，约有1万7000个电子门票二维码疑被盗取。

香港迪士尼乐园称，其在线票务系统遭到入侵，已于11月13日向警方报案。

对此，警方表示，案件暂列“有犯罪或不诚实意图而取用电脑”，已就此展开调查。

香港迪士尼乐园于2005年开业，是继日本之后亚洲的第二座迪士尼乐园，在截至2025年9月27日的一年里，已接待游客约750万人次。

特朗普称或在中国与金正恩举行会谈

美国总统特朗普透露，他可能会在中国与朝鲜劳动党总书记金正恩举行会谈。

特朗普11月16日离开白宫，先后前往菲律宾首都马尼拉和中国深圳。

临行前，特朗普对记者团表示：“我将在中国与习近平国家主席举行会晤，还将会晤俄罗斯总统普京。另外，我们或许还会与金正恩总书记会晤。这非常好，可以利用这个机会取得很多成果。”他以此表示可能会在中国与金正恩举行会谈。

在此之上，特朗普说：“金正恩可能也会来。我不确定。这要看习主席。”他以此暗示习近平和金正恩正在进行协调。不过，他没有透露具体的时间安排。

据俄罗斯国营通讯社塔斯社报道，俄罗斯总统新闻秘书佩斯科夫16日接受记者采访时，有记者问，如果金正恩出席在中国举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议，普京是否会与他举行会谈？对此，佩斯科夫回应称：“如果他参加亚太经合组织领导人会议，那当然会。”

items.body:
东盟-中国领导人会议16日在马尼拉举行

中国国务院总理李强11月16日在菲律宾首都马尼拉出席了东盟-中国领导人会议。

会议伊始，东盟轮值主席国菲律宾的总统马科斯表示：“东盟与中国一直致力于扩大贸易和投资合作。我们希望在现有合作成果的基础上进一步深化合作，以促进地区和平、稳定与繁荣。”

李强在发言中呼吁推进经贸合作，他表示：“尽管国际上各类经贸限制大幅增多，我们坚定维护多边主义、促进自由贸易。”

本次东盟-中国领导人会议以闭门形式举行。根据本台NHK获得的会议联合声明草案，声明包括推进在AI领域的技术合作与研发、加强在数字经济和供应链方面的合作等内容。

items.body:
黄瑞黎, ADAM SATARIANO, XINYUN WU, RIVER AKIRA DAVIS2026年11月17日

7月，黄仁勋在东京一家餐厅外参加完晚宴活动后，向记者们分发了零食。 Tomohiro Ohsumi/Getty Images

In Indonesia, Jensen Huang was called the leader of the artificial intelligence revolution. In Japan, he was “the next Steve Jobs,” according to the technology investor Masayoshi Son. In Taiwan, where he was born, he is just called Dad.

在印度尼西亚，黄仁勋被誉为人工智能革命的领军人物。在日本，科技投资人孙正义称他为“下一个史蒂夫·乔布斯”。在他出生的台湾，人们直接叫他“爸爸”。

Mr. Huang, who resigned this week from the powerhouse Silicon Valley chip company Nvidia, was celebrated across Asia — from South Korea to Japan, Indonesia to Kazakhstan. He traveled frequently to the region, cultivating close ties with business leaders and wooing government officials.

从韩国到日本，从印度尼西亚到哈萨克斯坦，上周从硅谷芯片巨头英伟达辞职的黄仁勋曾在亚洲各地广受赞誉。他频繁前往该地区，与商界领袖建立密切联系，并争取政府官员的支持。

Outside of China, he pitched Nvidia chips as a path to “sovereign A.I.,” the idea that countries had to build their own A.I. supercomputers and data centers, a vision that many government leaders bought into.

在中国以外，他将英伟达芯片推销为通往“主权人工智能”的路径，即各国必须建设自己的人工智能超级计算机和数据中心。许多政府领导人接受了这一愿景。

Even in China, where the business relationships he forged for Nvidia were made more complicated by the rivalry between Beijing and Washington, Mr. Huang was often seen as a bridge. That role was cast in a new light by the explosive revelations about his relationship with a woman the U.S. government believes was spying for China.

他说，企业可能很快面临一种“生存必需”，要用中国制造的芯片取代外国芯片。

“In the long run, whether China can benefit depends on whether domestically produced chips can truly narrow the technological gap,” he added.

“从长远看，中国能否受益取决于国产芯片能否真正缩小技术差距，”他还说。

华尔街知名科技分析师丹·艾夫斯说，从长远来看，黄仁勋离职是“中国梦想中的场景”。

“The biggest gating factor between the U.S. and China was Jensen and Nvidia,” Mr. Ives said.

“美中之间最大的关键制约因素就是黄仁勋和英伟达，”艾夫斯说。

One of the distinguishing features of Mr. Huang’s role in the Asia tech world was his ability to cultivate personal relationships with Nvidia’s suppliers that kept a steady stream of critical components flowing to the company.

黄仁勋在亚洲科技界角色的一个显著特点，是他有能力与英伟达供应商培养个人关系，使关键零部件稳定流向公司。

River Akira Davis常驻东京，报道日本经济和商业新闻。

“It is no exaggeration to say that the semiconductor supercycle we are currently riding is thanks to the A.I. ecosystem cultivated by Nvidia,” the Korea Economic Daily wrote in an editorial. “While one might argue that these are merely risks to be born by the C.E.O. personally, the issue lies in the fact that ‘Jensen Huang is, in effect, Nvidia itself.’”
“可以毫不夸张地说，我们目前所处的半导体超级周期，要归功于英伟达培育的人工智能生态系统，”《韩国经济日报》在一篇社论中写道。“虽然有人可能会说，这些只是首席执行官个人承担的风险，但问题在于，‘黄仁勋实际上就是英伟达本身’。”

In Southeast Asia, Mr. Huang’s departure “would put a damper on demand for A.I. compute in existing and future data centers,” according to Ong Kian Ming, Malaysia’s former deputy minister for investment, trade and industry.
马来西亚前投资、贸易和工业部副部长王建民说，在东南亚，黄仁勋离职“会抑制现有和未来数据中心对人工智能算力的需求”。
“Malaysia would take the brunt of the likely drop in demand, but this may also have spillover effects on Thailand and Indonesia,” Mr. Ong said.
“马来西亚将承受需求可能下降的主要冲击，但这也可能对泰国和印度尼西亚产生溢出效应，”王建民说。

On Friday, Malaysia said it was working to determine whether any A.I. chips imported by ​a unit of Megaspeed were re-exported. Megaspeed is the Singapore-based firm that is run by Alice Huang, the woman who had a relationship with Mr. Huang and who U.S. intelligence has determined was spying for China. China has denied the espionage claims. Megaspeed said in a statement that it has cooperated with U.S. government inspections and will continue to do so. Ms. Huang hasn’t been able to be reached.
周五，马来西亚表示正在调查Megaspeed旗下某子公司进口的任何人工智能芯片是否被转口。Megaspeed是一家新加坡公司，由黄乐(Alice Huang)经营。她与黄仁勋有恋爱关系，美国情报机构认定她为中国从事间谍活动。中国否认间谍指控。Megaspeed在一份声明中表示，它已配合美国政府检查，并将继续配合。目前无法联系到黄乐。

Mr. Huang was a rare chief executive who huddled with business titans over fried chicken and beer and mingled with the public while eating street food. He made it a point to meet many Asian officials on his trips, including China’s leader, Xi Jinping.
黄仁勋是一位罕见的首席执行官，他会与商业巨头一起吃炸鸡喝啤酒，也会在吃街头小吃时与公众交流。他特意在出行时会见许多亚洲官员，包括中国领导人习近平。

“What Southeast Asia will struggle to find is another Nvidia boss willing to fly in, sit down with its prime ministers and argue its case in Washington,” wrote Jude Chan, a journalist from The Business Times, a Singapore newspaper, which called Mr. Huang “Nvidia’s best salesman.”
“东南亚很难再找到另一位像黄仁勋这样，愿意专程飞来与各国总理会面，并在华盛顿为公司争取利益的英伟达老板，”新加坡《商业时报》记者裘德·陈（音）写道。该报称黄仁勋是“英伟达最好的销售员”。
Mr. Huang was seen as a megastar in Taiwan. His visits to Taipei are typically live streamed for hours at a time. The domestic media frenzy that surrounds his visits have been called “Jensanity.”
黄仁勋在台湾被视为超级明星。他每次造访台北，通常都会有长达数小时的直播。围绕他访问的本地媒体狂热被称为“仁来疯”。

He has met regularly with executives from TSMC, the Taiwanese giant that manufactures chips. He has hosted banquets for his Taiwanese suppliers, and is known particularly for his close relationship with TSMC’s founder, Morris Chang.
他定期与制造芯片的台湾巨头台积电高管会面。他为台湾供应商举办宴会，尤其以与台积电创始人张忠谋的密切关系闻名。

In Japan, which Mr. Huang visited in July, Mr. Huang said the country could use its prowess in manufacturing and industrial robots to become a leader in sovereign development of physical A.I. All it needed was to install tens of thousands of Nvidia chips.
黄仁勋于7月访问日本。在那里，他说，日本可以利用其制造业和工业机器人优势，成为实体人工智能自主研发的领导者。所需的仅仅是安装数万颗英伟达芯片。
Japan’s economy minister, Ryosei Akazawa, and dozens of Japanese corporate leaders attended a launch event in Tokyo for a tech consortium to build these physical A.I. models.
日本经济大臣赤泽亮正和数十名日本企业领袖出席了在东京举行的一场科技联盟启动仪式该活动旨在成立一个致力于构建此类实体人工智能模型的技术联盟。
Mr. Akazawa wore a black leather jacket. He told the audience his clothing choice was meant to express his “great respect” for Mr. Huang, who made leather jackets his signature look.
赤泽亮正穿着黑色皮夹克。他告诉观众，他的着装选择是为了表达对黄仁勋的“极大尊重”，而黄仁勋一直以皮夹克作为标志性造型。

Forty-four major Japanese companies ended up joining the consortium, including Sony Group, SoftBank, NEC and Honda. Share prices of companies whose executives reportedly shared meals with Mr. Huang on his Tokyo trip surged.
44家日本主要公司最终加入了该联盟，包括索尼集团、软银、NEC和本田。据报道，在黄仁勋东京之行期间与其共进晚餐的企业高管所在公司的股价均出现飙升。

At the time, analysts and researchers also questioned whether the state-backed initiative would actually further sovereign Japanese A.I. or just create a risky dependency on a single foreign company: Nvidia.
当时，分析人士和研究人员也质疑，这项由政府支持的举措究竟能否真正推动日本人工智能的自主发展，还是仅仅会造成对单一外国公司——英伟达——的风险性依赖。
Li You和Choe Sang-Hun自首尔、Zunaira Saieed自吉隆坡、艾莎(Alexandra Stevenson)自香港对本文有报道贡献。

items.body:
ANA SWANSON, TONY ROMM2026年11月17日

位于马来西亚柔佛州的一座正在建设中的Megaspeed数据中心。 Ulet Ifansasti for The New York Times

The Trump administration said on Monday that it was moving forward with a new rule that would clamp down on China’s ability to access advanced A.I. chips through the use of data centers outside China’s borders.

特朗普政府周一表示，正在推进一项新规定，旨在限制中国通过利用境外数据中心获取先进人工智能芯片的能力。

The rule aims to close what many in Washington see as a loophole allowing China to sidestep a ban that prevents Chinese firms from buying the most advanced A.I. chips made by companies like Nvidia. Chinese firms have continued to legally access the chips by renting them from data centers in Southeast Asia and elsewhere. Whether to close the loophole has been a significant source of contention within the Trump administration.

华盛顿许多人认为，中国利用一个漏洞规避了禁止中国企业购买由英伟达等公司制造的最先进人工智能芯片的禁令，这项规定就旨在堵住这一漏洞。中国企业一直通过从东南亚及其他地区的数据中心租用这些芯片，继续合法地获取它们。是否要堵住这个漏洞，一直是特朗普政府内部争论的重要源头。

The new rule is intended to make it harder for Chinese firms to remotely access the chips. It will require overseas data centers to obtain a government license before supplying “significant volumes of computing power” to firms with headquarters in a small group of high-risk countries, a list that includes China, Russia and Iran.

新规旨在使中国企业更难远程访问这些芯片。它将要求海外数据中心在向总部位于少数高风险国家（包括中国、俄罗斯和伊朗）的企业提供“大量计算能力”之前，必须获得政府许可。

Data centers are also required to perform strict checks on their customers to determine if they are linked to those countries. And the U.S. will now require a license to export advanced chips to companies with headquarters in Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand or Brazil, which have a higher than normal risk of smuggling, the administration said.

数据中心还被要求对其客户进行严格审查，以确定他们是否与这些国家有关联。此外，美国政府表示，美国现在将要求向总部位于印度尼西亚、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国或巴西的公司出口先进芯片时获得许可，因为这些国家走私的风险高于正常水平。

The provision, which goes into effect in 90 days, will “undermine” the ability of companies in those countries from using U.S. chips to train advanced A.I. models, the administration said in a news release.

政府在新闻稿中表示，该条款将于90天后生效，将“削弱”这些国家的企业使用美国芯片训练高级人工智能模型的能力。

The plan to crack down on China’s ability to access the coveted A.I. chips comes as President Trump is scheduled to travel to Asia. He will travel to the Philippines and then to China for an economic summit, where he is expected to meet with the Chinese leader, Xi Jinping and discuss the war in Iran, nuclear nonproliferation and trade. The data center rules could create a new source of friction between the countries, at a time when Mr. Trump has been trying to keep a fragile trade truce with China intact.

这项旨在遏制中国获取备受追捧的人工智能芯片能力的计划出台之际，特朗普总统正计划前往亚洲。他将先访问菲律宾，然后前往中国参加一场经济峰会。预计他将在那里与中国领导人习近平会面，讨论伊朗战争、核不扩散以及贸易问题。在特朗普一直试图维持与中国脆弱的贸易休战之际，数据中心的规定可能会成为两国之间新的摩擦源。

Share prices of chip stocks tumbled Monday. Nvidia fell more than 4 percent. Intel fell more than 7 percent, and Micron nearly 8 percent. Indexes that track these stocks fell too — the Philadelphia Semiconductor index sank more than 5 percent, and the broader, tech-heavy Nasdaq slumped, too.

芯片类股票的价格在周一暴跌。英伟达跌幅超过4%。英特尔跌幅超过7%，美光跌幅近8%。追踪这些股票的指数也出现了下跌——费城半导体指数下跌超过5%，范围更广、以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数也出现了大幅下挫。

The formerly obscure issue of chip sales to foreign data centers was thrust into the spotlight in recent weeks with the revelations about Megaspeed, a Singaporean data center firm created by a woman who had an affair with Jensen Huang, who was ousted as Nvidia’s chief executive last week. U.S. authorities deemed the woman, Alice Huang, to be an asset for Chinese intelligence services, and they are investigating Megaspeed over allegations of smuggling chips to China. (Chinese officials have denied that Ms. Huang is their spy.)

最近几周，随着关于Megaspeed的内幕曝光，原本鲜为人知的向外国数据中心销售芯片的问题被推到了聚光灯下。Megaspeed是一家新加坡数据中心公司，由一名曾与黄仁勋有过婚外情的女性创立，而黄仁勋上周刚被罢免了英伟达首席执行官的职务。美国当局认为这名名叫黄乐(Alice Huang)的女性是中国情报部门的线人，目前他们正就Megaspeed涉嫌向中国走私芯片一事进行调查。（中国官员否认黄乐是他们的间谍。）

Firms like Megaspeed have legally been able to operate data centers in Southeast Asia that remotely serve Chinese clients. That means Chinese companies that are blocked from buying advanced Nvidia chips directly can simply rent them through Southeast Asian firms.

像Megaspeed这样的公司一直能够在东南亚合法运营数据中心，为中国客户提供远程服务。这意味着那些被禁止直接购买先进英伟达芯片的中国公司只需通过东南亚公司租用这些芯片即可。

Nvidia and its proponents contend that the sales help create jobs in the United States and ensure that companies around the world are reliant on American technology.

英伟达及其支持者认为，这些销售有助于在美国创造就业机会，并确保世界各地的公司依赖美国技术。

But some officials in the Trump administration and in Congress increasingly appear to believe that Chinese access to these data centers has undercut U.S. export controls and allowed China’s artificial intelligence ecosystem to flourish. Some worry this could give Beijing an economic edge, as well as a military one.

但特朗普政府和国会的一些官员似乎越来越认为，中国能够访问这些数据中心削弱了美国的出口管制，让中国的人工智能生态系统得以蓬勃发展。一些人担心这可能会给北京带来经济和军事上的优势。

That scandal has turned China’s access to advanced A.I. computing power into a subject of debate at the highest levels of the administration, with the Commerce Department, which oversees the regulations, clashing over them with other parts of the government.

这桩丑闻使中国获取先进人工智能计算能力的问题成为政府最高层辩论的话题，负责监督这些规定的商务部在这一问题上与政府其他部门发生了冲突。

The debate has set Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, who oversees chip policy, at odds with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Secretary of State Marco Rubio and the U.S. trade representative, Jamieson Greer, who have all pushed to reinstate broad restrictions on data centers in recent months.

这场辩论使得负责芯片政策的商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克与财政部长斯科特·贝森特、国务卿马可·鲁比奥以及美国贸易代表贾米森·格里尔产生了分歧，后者在最近几个月里一直都在推动恢复对数据中心的广泛限制。

Mr. Lutnick had pushed for a leaner version of the rules on foreign data centers, one that would be less onerous for Nvidia and its customers.

卢特尼克曾推动制定一个更精简版的外国数据中心规定，该版本对英伟达及其客户来说负担较轻。

The announcement on Monday said that the new rule was “written by and at the direction of the Department of Treasury and the National Security Council” — both agencies that have pushed for more stringent rules.

周一的声明称，新规是“在财政部和国家安全委员会的指示下编写的”——这两个机构都曾推动制定更严格的规定。

Chris McGuire, a former Biden administration official who is now a senior fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations, said that the line was “completely unprecedented.”

前拜登政府官员、现任美国外交关系委员会高级研究员克里斯·麦奎尔表示，这句话“完全是史无前例的”。

“That implies that Commerce was dragged kicking and screaming over the finish line to publish the rule that the White House wanted,” he said.

“这意味着商务部是在强力施压下，不情不愿地被迫发布了白宫想要的那项规定，”他说。

Those tensions spilled out into the open on Friday, when Mr. Bessent blamed Mr. Lutnick’s department in a TV interview for failing to sanction Megaspeed, saying that other departments had pushed for the measure but that the Commerce Department “has the pen.” Mr. Bessent added that Nvidia should be “held accountable” if it did not do enough to prevent illegal diversion of chips to China.

这种紧张局势在周五公开化。当时贝森特在一次电视采访中指责卢特尼克的部门未能制裁Megaspeed，他表示其他部门曾推动这一措施，但商务部“掌握着决定权”。贝森特还说，如果英伟达在防止芯片被非法转移到中国方面做得不够，就应该“被追究责任”。

Both Mr. Bessent and Mr. Lutnick are traveling alongside Mr. Trump this week as he visits the Philippines and meets with Mr. Xi in China.

贝森特和卢特尼克本周都陪同特朗普出访，特朗普将访问菲律宾并在中国与习近平会面。

When asked about Mr. Bessent’s comments on Monday, Mr. Trump said there were just “two different views.”

当周一被问及贝森特的言论时，特朗普表示，这只是“两种不同的观点”。

“One view is, you don’t want to insult China,” the president said, adding: “The other view is, just go down and dirty and do what you have to do. You can’t say either is wrong or right.”

“一种观点是，你不想侮辱中国，”总统说。“另一种观点是，直接下手，做你必须做的事。你不能说哪一个是错的或是对的。”

10月，美国总统特朗普与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在华盛顿特区合影。

The president said that Mr. Lutnick might have delayed actions against Megaspeed, but that he was doing it because “if you didn’t delay it, if you didn’t do something, you could have a blowup with China.”

总统表示，卢特尼克可能推迟了针对Megaspeed的行动，但他之所以这么做，是因为“如果你不推迟，如果你不采取一些措施，你可能会与中国产生冲突。”

“I don’t think you want to insult China just before you get there,” he said.

“我认为你不想在到达中国之前侮辱中国，”他说。

Aruni Soni对本文有报道贡献。

Ana Swanson报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。

Tony Romm常驻华盛顿，为时报报道经济政策和特朗普政府新闻。

芯片类股票的价格在周一暴跌。英伟达跌幅超过4%。英特尔跌幅超过7%，美光跌幅近8%。追踪这些股票的指数也出现了下跌——费城半导体指数下跌超过5%，范围更广、以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数也出现了大幅下挫。

The formerly obscure issue of chip sales to foreign data centers was thrust into the spotlight in recent weeks with the revelations about Megaspeed, a Singaporean data center firm created by a woman who had an affair with Jensen Huang, who was ousted as Nvidia’s chief executive last week. U.S. authorities deemed the woman, Alice Huang, to be an asset for Chinese intelligence services, and they are investigating Megaspeed over allegations of smuggling chips to China. (Chinese officials have denied that Ms. Huang is their spy.)

最近几周，随着关于Megaspeed的内幕曝光，原本鲜为人知的向外国数据中心销售芯片的问题被推到了聚光灯下。Megaspeed是一家新加坡数据中心公司，由一名曾与黄仁勋有过婚外情的女性创立，而黄仁勋上周刚被罢免了英伟达首席执行官的职务。美国当局认为这名名叫黄乐(Alice Huang)的女性是中国情报部门的线人，目前他们正就Megaspeed涉嫌向中国走私芯片一事进行调查。（中国官员否认黄乐是他们的间谍。）

Firms like Megaspeed have legally been able to operate data centers in Southeast Asia that remotely serve Chinese clients. That means Chinese companies that are blocked from buying advanced Nvidia chips directly can simply rent them through Southeast Asian firms.
像Megaspeed这样的公司一直能够在东南亚合法运营数据中心，为中国客户提供远程服务。这意味着那些被禁止直接购买先进英伟达芯片的中国公司只需通过东南亚公司租用这些芯片即可。
Nvidia and its proponents contend that the sales help create jobs in the United States and ensure that companies around the world are reliant on American technology.
英伟达及其支持者认为，这些销售有助于在美国创造就业机会，并确保世界各地的公司依赖美国技术。

But some officials in the Trump administration and in Congress increasingly appear to believe that Chinese access to these data centers has undercut U.S. export controls and allowed China’s artificial intelligence ecosystem to flourish. Some worry this could give Beijing an economic edge, as well as a military one.
但特朗普政府和国会的一些官员似乎越来越认为，中国能够访问这些数据中心削弱了美国的出口管制，让中国的人工智能生态系统得以蓬勃发展。一些人担心这可能会给北京带来经济和军事上的优势。

That scandal has turned China’s access to advanced A.I. computing power into a subject of debate at the highest levels of the administration, with the Commerce Department, which oversees the regulations, clashing over them with other parts of the government.
这桩丑闻使中国获取先进人工智能计算能力的问题成为政府最高层辩论的话题，负责监督这些规定的商务部在这一问题上与政府其他部门发生了冲突。

The debate has set Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, who oversees chip policy, at odds with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Secretary of State Marco Rubio and the U.S. trade representative, Jamieson Greer, who have all pushed to reinstate broad restrictions on data centers in recent months.
这场辩论使得负责芯片政策的商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克与财政部长斯科特·贝森特、国务卿马可·鲁比奥以及美国贸易代表贾米森·格里尔产生了分歧，后者在最近几个月里一直都在推动恢复对数据中心的广泛限制。
Mr. Lutnick had pushed for a leaner version of the rules on foreign data centers, one that would be less onerous for Nvidia and its customers.
卢特尼克曾推动制定一个更精简版的外国数据中心规定，该版本对英伟达及其客户来说负担较轻。

The announcement on Monday said that the new rule was “written by and at the direction of the Department of Treasury and the National Security Council” — both agencies that have pushed for more stringent rules.
周一的声明称，新规是“在财政部和国家安全委员会的指示下编写的”——这两个机构都曾推动制定更严格的规定。
Chris McGuire, a former Biden administration official who is now a senior fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations, said that the line was “completely unprecedented.”
前拜登政府官员、现任美国外交关系委员会高级研究员克里斯·麦奎尔表示，这句话“完全是史无前例的”。
“That implies that Commerce was dragged kicking and screaming over the finish line to publish the rule that the White House wanted,” he said.
“这意味着商务部是在强力施压下，不情不愿地被迫发布了白宫想要的那项规定，”他说。

Those tensions spilled out into the open on Friday, when Mr. Bessent blamed Mr. Lutnick’s department in a TV interview for failing to sanction Megaspeed, saying that other departments had pushed for the measure but that the Commerce Department “has the pen.” Mr. Bessent added that Nvidia should be “held accountable” if it did not do enough to prevent illegal diversion of chips to China.
这种紧张局势在周五公开化。当时贝森特在一次电视采访中指责卢特尼克的部门未能制裁Megaspeed，他表示其他部门曾推动这一措施，但商务部“掌握着决定权”。贝森特还说，如果英伟达在防止芯片被非法转移到中国方面做得不够，就应该“被追究责任”。
Both Mr. Bessent and Mr. Lutnick are traveling alongside Mr. Trump this week as he visits the Philippines and meets with Mr. Xi in China.
贝森特和卢特尼克本周都陪同特朗普出访，特朗普将访问菲律宾并在中国与习近平会面。
When asked about Mr. Bessent’s comments on Monday, Mr. Trump said there were just “two different views.”
当周一被问及贝森特的言论时，特朗普表示，这只是“两种不同的观点”。
“One view is, you don’t want to insult China,” the president said, adding: “The other view is, just go down and dirty and do what you have to do. You can’t say either is wrong or right.”
“一种观点是，你不想侮辱中国，”总统说。“另一种观点是，直接下手，做你必须做的事。你不能说哪一个是错的或是对的。”
10月，美国总统特朗普与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在华盛顿特区合影。

The president said that Mr. Lutnick might have delayed actions against Megaspeed, but that he was doing it because “if you didn’t delay it, if you didn’t do something, you could have a blowup with China.”
总统表示，卢特尼克可能推迟了针对Megaspeed的行动，但他之所以这么做，是因为“如果你不推迟，如果你不采取一些措施，你可能会与中国产生冲突。”
“I don’t think you want to insult China just before you get there,” he said.
“我认为你不想在到达中国之前侮辱中国，”他说。
Aruni Soni对本文有报道贡献。
Ana Swanson报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。
Tony Romm常驻华盛顿，为时报报道经济政策和特朗普政府新闻。
