items.summary: 关于特朗普访华及中美俄首脑会晤，你应该了解的 Telegraph | 原文链接 | 频道大全
items.body:
郭莉莉2026年11月17日

俄罗斯艺术家阿列克谢·谢尔吉延科创作的绘画作品，描绘了美国、俄罗斯和中国的领导人。这幅画于周四在俄罗斯圣彼得堡首次亮相。 Andrei Bok/Reuters

President Trump sets off this week for meetings in Asia that will culminate in a summit with two strongmen he has often praised: President Xi Jinping of China and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia.

特朗普总统本周将启程前往亚洲参加一系列会议，行程的高潮将是与两位他常加赞赏的强人举行峰会：中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统普京。

It will be the first time the three men, who command the world’s largest nuclear arsenals, will have sat down together. Mr. Trump plans to discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world and the war against Iran, according to a White House spokeswoman. He is not expected to bring up Russia’s war with Ukraine.

这将是三位掌握全球最大核武库的领导人首次坐在一起。据白宫发言人称，特朗普计划讨论削减全球核武器以及对伊朗的战争问题。预计他不会提及俄乌战争。

Mr. Trump will travel first to Manila, then to southern China, and will meet with regional leaders confronting an array of uncertainties. Those include the course of the war between the United States and Iran, high energy prices and mounting concern over the risks of artificial intelligence.

特朗普将首先前往马尼拉，随后是中国南部，与面临一系列不确定性的地区领导人举行会晤。这些不确定性包括美伊战争将如何发展、居高不下的能源价格，以及人们对人工智能风险日益加剧的担忧。

For Mr. Trump, the trip will be a pivot to foreign policy and relationships after American voters delivered a swift rebuke to his party in the midterm elections. His trip also comes as his administration faces scrutiny over a scandal involving the former chief executive of Nvidia, the tech giant, which has raised questions about Chinese espionage and American tech exports.

对于特朗普而言，在美国选民于中期选举中迅速对其所属政党表达不满之后，此行将是一次转向外交政策和对外关系的调整。与此同时，特朗普政府正因一起涉及科技巨头英伟达前首席执行官的丑闻而受到审视，该丑闻引发了关于中国间谍活动和美国技术出口的质疑。

Echoes of Yalta

雅尔塔会议的回响

The highlight of Mr. Trump’s trip is expected to be his meeting with Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin on Thursday in China.

预计特朗普此次出访的重头戏将是周四在中国与习近平和普京举行的会晤。

The prospect of their summit has drawn comparisons to the 1945 conference in the Crimean city of Yalta, where the leaders of the United States, the Soviet Union and Britain met to decide the shape of postwar Europe.

这场峰会让人联想到1945年在克里米亚城市雅尔塔举行的会议。当时，美苏英三国领导人举行会晤，以决定战后欧洲的格局。

The White House has said that Mr. Trump wants to discuss the threat of nuclear proliferation. U.S. officials have expressed concerns about China’s accelerating nuclear buildup, expected to reach 1,000 nuclear warheads by 2030.

白宫表示，特朗普希望讨论核扩散威胁。美国官员对中国加速扩充核武库表示担忧，预计到2030年，中国的核弹头数量将达到1000枚。

The last nuclear arms control treaty between the United States and Russia expired in February. Trump administration officials have said that any new agreement on nuclear arms control must include China, but Beijing has shown no interest in the topic. China has an estimated 620 nuclear warheads, compared with the more than 5,000 that Russia and the United States have each, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute.

美俄之间的最后一项核军控条约已于今年2月到期。特朗普政府官员表示，任何新的核军控协议都必须包括中国，但北京方面对此毫无兴趣。据斯德哥尔摩国际和平研究所估计，中国约有620枚核弹头，而俄罗斯和美国各拥有5000多枚。

北京去年举行阅兵式，展示了东风-61型核导弹。中国拥有全球增长速度最快的核武库，并已明确表示无意参与军控谈判。

U.S. administration officials said they did not expect a deal out of the meeting, which they characterized as a starting point for discussions.

美国政府官员表示，他们不指望此次会晤能够达成协议，而是将其视为开启相关讨论的一个起点。

The gathering has prompted concern in Ukraine that Mr. Putin might push for a deal, deciding Ukraine’s fate without Kyiv’s involvement. A U.S. administration official said Ukraine was not expected to be part of the discussion between the three leaders.

这场会晤引发了乌克兰的担忧，担心普京可能推动达成一项协议，在基辅未参与的情况下决定乌克兰的命运。一名美国政府官员表示，预计乌克兰问题不会列入三位领导人的讨论议程。

U.S. Partners Look for Reassurance

美国盟友寻求安心保证

Mr. Trump will start his trip in the Philippines, the oldest American treaty ally in the Asia-Pacific region, as the United States faces questions about its support for its partners in a region where China’s military and economic might continues to grow.

特朗普此行的第一站是菲律宾。菲律宾是美国在亚太地区最早的条约盟友。随着中国的军事和经济实力不断增强，外界也对美国是否会坚定支持该地区的伙伴产生了疑虑。

In Manila, President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. plans to discuss with Mr. Trump the South China Sea, where the Philippines and China have competing claims. Philippine officials have said that they hope Mr. Trump’s visit might result in more American military assistance.

在马尼拉，菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯计划与特朗普讨论南中国海问题。菲中两国在这里存在相互冲突的主权主张。菲律宾官员表示，他们希望特朗普的访问能够带来更多美国军事援助。

菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯周日在马尼拉举行的东盟峰会上发言。菲律宾官员希望特朗普的访问能够为该国带来更多美国军事援助。

Mr. Trump is also expected to meet with leaders of ASEAN, a Southeast Asian grouping of 11 nations, as well as a gathering of the so-called Quad grouping of the United States, India, Australia and Japan.

预计特朗普还将会见东盟领导人。东盟是由11个国家组成的东南亚集团。他还将参加所谓“四方安全对话”领导人会议，该对话机制包括美国、印度、澳大利亚和日本。

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese of Australia said on Sunday that he expected “lots of engagement” with Mr. Trump during the meetings.

澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯周日表示，他预计将在这些会议期间与特朗普进行“大量交流”。

“Obviously, that’s our most important ally,” he said. “But we want to see something constructive come out of that, including we want to see a de-escalation in the conflicts that are around the world.”

“显然，美国是我们最重要的盟友，”他说。“但我们希望这些交流能够取得一些建设性成果，包括推动世界各地的冲突降温。”

Chinese analysts described the meeting of the Quad group, formed in part to counter China, as an effort by Mr. Trump to project power after his party’s defeat in the midterms. “Its symbolic value outweighs its practical value,” Xu Liping, a senior scholar at Guangdong University of Foreign Studies, told Shanghai Observer, a state-run outlet.

中国分析人士认为，部分旨在制衡中国的“四方安全对话”机制此次举行会议，是特朗普试图在其所属政党中期选举失利后展示实力的一种方式。“其象征意义大于实际效用，”广东外语外贸大学高级研究员许利平在接受中国官媒《上观新闻》采访时表示。

The Spy Scandal

间谍丑闻

After Manila, Mr. Trump will travel to the Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen, where he will meet Mr. Xi on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation.

离开马尼拉后，特朗普将前往中国科技中心深圳，在亚太经济合作组织会议期间与习近平会晤。

Jensen Huang, a key adviser who accompanied Mr. Trump on his last trip to China, will not be by his side. Mr. Huang helped shape the president’s views about technological competition with China and persuaded him to loosen restrictions on selling advanced chips to China.

曾陪同特朗普上次访华的重要顾问黄仁勋这次将不会随行。黄仁勋曾帮助塑造特朗普对美中科技竞争的看法，并说服他放宽向中国出售先进芯片的限制。

Mr. Huang stepped down from his role at Nvidia after revelations that he had an affair with a Chinese businesswoman, Alice Huang, who U.S. intelligence officials believe was collecting intelligence on Mr. Huang for Beijing. China has rejected the allegations, calling them “smears.” Ms. Huang has not responded to requests for comment.

在与中国商界女性黄乐(Alice Huang)发生婚外情的消息曝光后，黄仁勋辞去了英伟达的职务。美国情报官员认为，黄乐一直在为北京方面收集有关黄仁勋的情报。中国否认了这些指控，称其为“抹黑”。黄乐未回应置评请求。

So far, the president has not raised the issue with Mr. Xi and is not expected to during their meeting on Thursday. But the saga is likely to cause unease in China about whether Washington will impose tighter controls on the export of technology to the country.

迄今为止，特朗普尚未向习近平提起此事，预计也不会在周四的会晤中讨论。但这场风波可能会让中国感到不安，担心华盛顿将对向中国出口技术实施更严格管控。

As a result, U.S.-based analysts speculated that Mr. Xi might try to use his personal relationship with Mr. Trump to forestall such restrictions.

因此，美国的分析人士推测，习近平可能试图利用自己与特朗普的私人关系，阻止美国进一步收紧相关限制。

今年9月，时任英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在白宫为习近平举行的国宴上与特朗普同桌。黄仁勋此前曾陪同特朗普访问中国，但这次不会随行。

Yun Sun, director of the China program at the Stimson Center in Washington, said Mr. Huang’s downfall would likely mean “there is going to be more anxiety on the Chinese side about their access to American chips.” She expects Mr. Xi to emphasize the importance of easing U.S. controls on chip exports to China during their meeting.

华盛顿史汀生中心中国项目主任孙韵表示，黄仁勋的陨落可能意味着“中国将更加担忧能否获得美国芯片”。她预计，习近平将在会晤中强调放宽美国对华芯片出口管制的重要性。

Cooperation between China and the United States on artificial intelligence may be more difficult after the Nvidia scandal.

英伟达丑闻发生后，中美两国在人工智能领域的合作可能变得更加困难。

Still, there may be progress on the creation of a notification system that would allow the countries to alert each other about national security issues related to artificial intelligence, which the two sides agreed to in September.

不过，双方在建立通报机制方面仍可能取得进展。根据两国今年9月达成的协议，这一机制将允许双方就涉及人工智能的国家安全问题相互发出预警。

“There’s some shared concern on both sides that U.S. or Chinese models might be misused by bad actors and cause damage to the U.S., China, or other countries,” said Kyle Chan, a fellow at the Brookings Institution focusing on China’s technology development.

“双方都在一定程度上担心，美国或中国的人工智能模型可能被不法分子滥用，从而对双方或其他国家造成损害，”布鲁金斯学会研究中国科技发展的研究员凯尔·陈(Kyle Chan)说。

Xi May Have a New Calculus

习近平可能有新的考量

When Mr. Xi sits down with Mr. Trump in Shenzhen, he will be dealing with a president who will soon face a new constraint at home: a Democrat-controlled Congress.

当习近平在深圳与特朗普坐下来会谈时，他面对的将是一位很快会在国内受到新制约的总统——国会将由民主党控制。

Lawmakers may pressure Mr. Trump to tighten export controls against China or accelerate weapons sales to Taiwan, according to Ali Wyne, a senior research and advocacy adviser focusing on U.S.-China relations at the International Crisis Group. That means that “Xi will have to work much harder to keep Trump on side,” Mr. Wyne said.

国际危机组织专注美中关系研究的高级研究与倡导顾问阿里·怀恩表示，国会议员可能向特朗普施压，要求他收紧对华出口管制，或加快对台军售。这意味着，“习近平将不得不付出更大努力，才能让特朗普继续站在自己这一边”，怀恩说。

Mr. Trump will be the first American president to visit China twice in one calendar year.

特朗普将成为首位在一个自然年内两次访华的美国总统。

Analysts say the leaders’ summits, which have included state visits in Beijing and then in Washington, have been the only thing holding together a fragile détente between the two countries as they clash over A.I., export controls, Taiwan and other issues.

分析人士称，在两国围绕人工智能、出口管制、台湾等问题不断发生摩擦之际，领导人峰会——包括此前分别在北京和华盛顿进行的国事访问——一直是维系双方脆弱缓和关系的唯一支柱。

The two sides declared a trade truce last year when they met in Busan, South Korea. That deal, which was to expire this month, has been extended until January.

去年，双方在韩国釜山会晤时宣布达成贸易休战协议。该协议原定于本月到期，如今已延长至明年1月。

去年，特朗普与习近平在韩国釜山举行会晤后。分析人士表示，两国领导人之间的峰会一直是维系双方脆弱缓和关系的唯一支柱。

China’s restrictions on the export of crucial rare-earth metals and rare-earth magnets, which are needed to manufacture most modern technology, remain one of the most difficult unresolved issues.

中国对关键稀土金属和稀土磁体实施的出口限制仍是双方悬而未决的最棘手问题之一。它们是制造大多数现代科技产品所必不可少的材料。

Mr. Trump is likely to raise this with Mr. Xi, according to a senior U.S. administration official who said that China’s continued restrictions is one reason Washington only agreed to a two-month extension of the trade truce.

据一名美国高级政府官员称，特朗普可能会向中国国家主席提出这一问题。该官员表示，中国继续实施限制是华盛顿只同意将贸易休战延长两个月的原因之一。

Ana Swanson自华盛顿、Aie Balagtas自马尼拉、Laura Chung自悉尼对本文有报道贡献。

俄罗斯艺术家阿列克谢·谢尔吉延科创作的绘画作品，描绘了美国、俄罗斯和中国的领导人。这幅画于周四在俄罗斯圣彼得堡首次亮相。 Andrei Bok/Reuters

President Trump sets off this week for meetings in Asia that will culminate in a summit with two strongmen he has often praised: President Xi Jinping of China and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia.
特朗普总统本周将启程前往亚洲参加一系列会议，行程的高潮将是与两位他常加赞赏的强人举行峰会：中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统普京。

It will be the first time the three men, who command the world’s largest nuclear arsenals, will have sat down together. Mr. Trump plans to discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world and the war against Iran, according to a White House spokeswoman. He is not expected to bring up Russia’s war with Ukraine.
这将是三位掌握全球最大核武库的领导人首次坐在一起。据白宫发言人称，特朗普计划讨论削减全球核武器以及对伊朗的战争问题。预计他不会提及俄乌战争。

Mr. Trump will travel first to Manila, then to southern China, and will meet with regional leaders confronting an array of uncertainties. Those include the course of the war between the United States and Iran, high energy prices and mounting concern over the risks of artificial intelligence.
特朗普将首先前往马尼拉，随后是中国南部，与面临一系列不确定性的地区领导人举行会晤。这些不确定性包括美伊战争将如何发展、居高不下的能源价格，以及人们对人工智能风险日益加剧的担忧。

For Mr. Trump, the trip will be a pivot to foreign policy and relationships after American voters delivered a swift rebuke to his party in the midterm elections. His trip also comes as his administration faces scrutiny over a scandal involving the former chief executive of Nvidia, the tech giant, which has raised questions about Chinese espionage and American tech exports.
对于特朗普而言，在美国选民于中期选举中迅速对其所属政党表达不满之后，此行将是一次转向外交政策和对外关系的调整。与此同时，特朗普政府正因一起涉及科技巨头英伟达前首席执行官的丑闻而受到审视，该丑闻引发了关于中国间谍活动和美国技术出口的质疑。
Echoes of Yalta
雅尔塔会议的回响
The highlight of Mr. Trump’s trip is expected to be his meeting with Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin on Thursday in China.
预计特朗普此次出访的重头戏将是周四在中国与习近平和普京举行的会晤。

The prospect of their summit has drawn comparisons to the 1945 conference in the Crimean city of Yalta, where the leaders of the United States, the Soviet Union and Britain met to decide the shape of postwar Europe.
这场峰会让人联想到1945年在克里米亚城市雅尔塔举行的会议。当时，美苏英三国领导人举行会晤，以决定战后欧洲的格局。

The White House has said that Mr. Trump wants to discuss the threat of nuclear proliferation. U.S. officials have expressed concerns about China’s accelerating nuclear buildup, expected to reach 1,000 nuclear warheads by 2030.
白宫表示，特朗普希望讨论核扩散威胁。美国官员对中国加速扩充核武库表示担忧，预计到2030年，中国的核弹头数量将达到1000枚。

The last nuclear arms control treaty between the United States and Russia expired in February. Trump administration officials have said that any new agreement on nuclear arms control must include China, but Beijing has shown no interest in the topic. China has an estimated 620 nuclear warheads, compared with the more than 5,000 that Russia and the United States have each, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute.
美俄之间的最后一项核军控条约已于今年2月到期。特朗普政府官员表示，任何新的核军控协议都必须包括中国，但北京方面对此毫无兴趣。据斯德哥尔摩国际和平研究所估计，中国约有620枚核弹头，而俄罗斯和美国各拥有5000多枚。
北京去年举行阅兵式，展示了东风-61型核导弹。中国拥有全球增长速度最快的核武库，并已明确表示无意参与军控谈判。
U.S. administration officials said they did not expect a deal out of the meeting, which they characterized as a starting point for discussions.
美国政府官员表示，他们不指望此次会晤能够达成协议，而是将其视为开启相关讨论的一个起点。

The gathering has prompted concern in Ukraine that Mr. Putin might push for a deal, deciding Ukraine’s fate without Kyiv’s involvement. A U.S. administration official said Ukraine was not expected to be part of the discussion between the three leaders.
这场会晤引发了乌克兰的担忧，担心普京可能推动达成一项协议，在基辅未参与的情况下决定乌克兰的命运。一名美国政府官员表示，预计乌克兰问题不会列入三位领导人的讨论议程。
U.S. Partners Look for Reassurance
美国盟友寻求安心保证

Mr. Trump will start his trip in the Philippines, the oldest American treaty ally in the Asia-Pacific region, as the United States faces questions about its support for its partners in a region where China’s military and economic might continues to grow.
特朗普此行的第一站是菲律宾。菲律宾是美国在亚太地区最早的条约盟友。随着中国的军事和经济实力不断增强，外界也对美国是否会坚定支持该地区的伙伴产生了疑虑。

In Manila, President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. plans to discuss with Mr. Trump the South China Sea, where the Philippines and China have competing claims. Philippine officials have said that they hope Mr. Trump’s visit might result in more American military assistance.
在马尼拉，菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯计划与特朗普讨论南中国海问题。菲中两国在这里存在相互冲突的主权主张。菲律宾官员表示，他们希望特朗普的访问能够带来更多美国军事援助。
菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯周日在马尼拉举行的东盟峰会上发言。菲律宾官员希望特朗普的访问能够为该国带来更多美国军事援助。

Mr. Trump is also expected to meet with leaders of ASEAN, a Southeast Asian grouping of 11 nations, as well as a gathering of the so-called Quad grouping of the United States, India, Australia and Japan.
预计特朗普还将会见东盟领导人。东盟是由11个国家组成的东南亚集团。他还将参加所谓“四方安全对话”领导人会议，该对话机制包括美国、印度、澳大利亚和日本。
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese of Australia said on Sunday that he expected “lots of engagement” with Mr. Trump during the meetings.
澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯周日表示，他预计将在这些会议期间与特朗普进行“大量交流”。

“Obviously, that’s our most important ally,” he said. “But we want to see something constructive come out of that, including we want to see a de-escalation in the conflicts that are around the world.”
“显然，美国是我们最重要的盟友，”他说。“但我们希望这些交流能够取得一些建设性成果，包括推动世界各地的冲突降温。”

Chinese analysts described the meeting of the Quad group, formed in part to counter China, as an effort by Mr. Trump to project power after his party’s defeat in the midterms. “Its symbolic value outweighs its practical value,” Xu Liping, a senior scholar at Guangdong University of Foreign Studies, told Shanghai Observer, a state-run outlet.
中国分析人士认为，部分旨在制衡中国的“四方安全对话”机制此次举行会议，是特朗普试图在其所属政党中期选举失利后展示实力的一种方式。“其象征意义大于实际效用，”广东外语外贸大学高级研究员许利平在接受中国官媒《上观新闻》采访时表示。
The Spy Scandal
间谍丑闻
After Manila, Mr. Trump will travel to the Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen, where he will meet Mr. Xi on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation.
离开马尼拉后，特朗普将前往中国科技中心深圳，在亚太经济合作组织会议期间与习近平会晤。

Jensen Huang, a key adviser who accompanied Mr. Trump on his last trip to China, will not be by his side. Mr. Huang helped shape the president’s views about technological competition with China and persuaded him to loosen restrictions on selling advanced chips to China.
曾陪同特朗普上次访华的重要顾问黄仁勋这次将不会随行。黄仁勋曾帮助塑造特朗普对美中科技竞争的看法，并说服他放宽向中国出售先进芯片的限制。

Mr. Huang stepped down from his role at Nvidia after revelations that he had an affair with a Chinese businesswoman, Alice Huang, who U.S. intelligence officials believe was collecting intelligence on Mr. Huang for Beijing. China has rejected the allegations, calling them “smears.” Ms. Huang has not responded to requests for comment.
在与中国商界女性黄乐(Alice Huang)发生婚外情的消息曝光后，黄仁勋辞去了英伟达的职务。美国情报官员认为，黄乐一直在为北京方面收集有关黄仁勋的情报。中国否认了这些指控，称其为“抹黑”。黄乐未回应置评请求。

So far, the president has not raised the issue with Mr. Xi and is not expected to during their meeting on Thursday. But the saga is likely to cause unease in China about whether Washington will impose tighter controls on the export of technology to the country.
迄今为止，特朗普尚未向习近平提起此事，预计也不会在周四的会晤中讨论。但这场风波可能会让中国感到不安，担心华盛顿将对向中国出口技术实施更严格管控。
As a result, U.S.-based analysts speculated that Mr. Xi might try to use his personal relationship with Mr. Trump to forestall such restrictions.
因此，美国的分析人士推测，习近平可能试图利用自己与特朗普的私人关系，阻止美国进一步收紧相关限制。
今年9月，时任英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在白宫为习近平举行的国宴上与特朗普同桌。黄仁勋此前曾陪同特朗普访问中国，但这次不会随行。

Yun Sun, director of the China program at the Stimson Center in Washington, said Mr. Huang’s downfall would likely mean “there is going to be more anxiety on the Chinese side about their access to American chips.” She expects Mr. Xi to emphasize the importance of easing U.S. controls on chip exports to China during their meeting.
华盛顿史汀生中心中国项目主任孙韵表示，黄仁勋的陨落可能意味着“中国将更加担忧能否获得美国芯片”。她预计，习近平将在会晤中强调放宽美国对华芯片出口管制的重要性。
Cooperation between China and the United States on artificial intelligence may be more difficult after the Nvidia scandal.
英伟达丑闻发生后，中美两国在人工智能领域的合作可能变得更加困难。

Still, there may be progress on the creation of a notification system that would allow the countries to alert each other about national security issues related to artificial intelligence, which the two sides agreed to in September.
不过，双方在建立通报机制方面仍可能取得进展。根据两国今年9月达成的协议，这一机制将允许双方就涉及人工智能的国家安全问题相互发出预警。

“There’s some shared concern on both sides that U.S. or Chinese models might be misused by bad actors and cause damage to the U.S., China, or other countries,” said Kyle Chan, a fellow at the Brookings Institution focusing on China’s technology development.
“双方都在一定程度上担心，美国或中国的人工智能模型可能被不法分子滥用，从而对双方或其他国家造成损害，”布鲁金斯学会研究中国科技发展的研究员凯尔·陈(Kyle Chan)说。
Xi May Have a New Calculus
习近平可能有新的考量
When Mr. Xi sits down with Mr. Trump in Shenzhen, he will be dealing with a president who will soon face a new constraint at home: a Democrat-controlled Congress.
当习近平在深圳与特朗普坐下来会谈时，他面对的将是一位很快会在国内受到新制约的总统——国会将由民主党控制。

Lawmakers may pressure Mr. Trump to tighten export controls against China or accelerate weapons sales to Taiwan, according to Ali Wyne, a senior research and advocacy adviser focusing on U.S.-China relations at the International Crisis Group. That means that “Xi will have to work much harder to keep Trump on side,” Mr. Wyne said.
国际危机组织专注美中关系研究的高级研究与倡导顾问阿里·怀恩表示，国会议员可能向特朗普施压，要求他收紧对华出口管制，或加快对台军售。这意味着，“习近平将不得不付出更大努力，才能让特朗普继续站在自己这一边”，怀恩说。
Mr. Trump will be the first American president to visit China twice in one calendar year.
特朗普将成为首位在一个自然年内两次访华的美国总统。

Analysts say the leaders’ summits, which have included state visits in Beijing and then in Washington, have been the only thing holding together a fragile détente between the two countries as they clash over A.I., export controls, Taiwan and other issues.
分析人士称，在两国围绕人工智能、出口管制、台湾等问题不断发生摩擦之际，领导人峰会——包括此前分别在北京和华盛顿进行的国事访问——一直是维系双方脆弱缓和关系的唯一支柱。
The two sides declared a trade truce last year when they met in Busan, South Korea. That deal, which was to expire this month, has been extended until January.
去年，双方在韩国釜山会晤时宣布达成贸易休战协议。该协议原定于本月到期，如今已延长至明年1月。
去年，特朗普与习近平在韩国釜山举行会晤后。分析人士表示，两国领导人之间的峰会一直是维系双方脆弱缓和关系的唯一支柱。
China’s restrictions on the export of crucial rare-earth metals and rare-earth magnets, which are needed to manufacture most modern technology, remain one of the most difficult unresolved issues.
中国对关键稀土金属和稀土磁体实施的出口限制仍是双方悬而未决的最棘手问题之一。它们是制造大多数现代科技产品所必不可少的材料。

Mr. Trump is likely to raise this with Mr. Xi, according to a senior U.S. administration official who said that China’s continued restrictions is one reason Washington only agreed to a two-month extension of the trade truce.
据一名美国高级政府官员称，特朗普可能会向中国国家主席提出这一问题。该官员表示，中国继续实施限制是华盛顿只同意将贸易休战延长两个月的原因之一。

items.body:
iPhone Duo 新增人脸识别解锁

11月17日，苹果正式推送了iOS 27.3开发者预览版Beta 2。

在上个版本中，苹果向中国大陆市场开放了Apple智能的测试，而这次的更新也达成了新的里程碑。

苹果在iOS 27.3 Beta 2中，为iPhone Duo机型加入了前摄人脸识别功能，可以通过摄像头进行面部识别解锁，这对于大家吐槽的侧边指纹解锁有所补充，体验会更强。

值得注意的是，甚至机主不睁眼也能解锁成功，这与多年来苹果一直强调的安全性完全相悖。

不过苹果还是做了一些补救，面部识别解锁仅在锁屏界面生效，Apple Pay支付、添加密码与账号登录等需要强认证的场景，仍需通过Touch ID完成身份校验。

启用摄像头解锁前，用户需要近期完成过Touch ID或密码认证，设备闲置约45分钟后将再次要求使用Touch ID验证。

该开关可在设置App的Touch ID与密码栏目中开启，系统在原有指纹与密码方案之上叠加面部识别作为辅助解锁手段，并未取消Touch ID在高安全等级场景中的认证地位。

同版本测试版还为iPhone Duo新增一项锁屏显示选项，用户可选择合上设备时直接锁定机身，而不再将内容自动转移至外屏显示，该选项位于设置App的显示与亮度栏目中，方便按使用习惯调整折叠状态下的屏幕行为。

俄罗斯国防部11月16日表示，共拦截乌克兰发射的1336架无人机。该数量是俄罗斯声称击落的最多的一次。此外，乌克兰还打击了克里米亚大桥，俄罗斯称损失不大。

items.body:
张爱玲作品《赤地之恋》、《秧歌》豆瓣词条下架

作家张爱玲的两部小说《赤地之恋》和《秧歌》，在中国社交网站豆瓣的词条近日被发现下架。

目前，在豆瓣网站搜索这两部作品，已无法找到张爱玲的相关书籍条目，而此前的豆瓣书籍链接也显示“这个页面不在了”。下架前，《秧歌》在豆瓣的评分为9.4分，共有1837人参与评分；《赤地之恋》的评分则为8.5分，共有783人参与评分。

两部作品均为张爱玲旅居香港期间创作的小说，具有政治色彩，主要描写1950年代初中国社会的政治运动及其对普通人的影响。

《赤地之恋》以中国土地改革、“三反”运动和朝鲜战争为背景，讲述大学毕业生刘荃满怀理想投身新社会建设，却在目睹土改暴力、政治斗争和战争的残酷后，理想逐渐幻灭的故事。

1954年出版的《秧歌》则聚焦土地改革后的中国农村，讲述农民金根和妻子月香一家在饥饿与贫困中挣扎求生的故事。小说通过官方宣传的农村丰收景象与农民食不果腹的现实之间的反差，描写政治运动下底层百姓的苦难。

上个月，张爱玲罕见演讲原声录音在中文互联网热传。在演讲中，张爱玲谈了许多与文学相关的内容，此外，她还提到中共的文艺路线、1949年后文艺创作环境的变化、五四运动的影响等。

阿里发布新一代旗舰大模型 网安防御能力大幅提升

阿里巴巴星期一（11月16日）发布新一代旗舰大模型Qwen4-Max。公司介绍，新模型提升了处理复杂专业及任务的能力，同时针对攻击性用途的防护能力显著增强。

综合“阿里研究院”微信公众号、路透社等报道，阿里巴巴发布新一代基座大模型Qwen4-Max，总参数2.4T。官方称，Qwen4-Max以更少的Token消耗实现了更高的性能，在智能体和编程等关键能力项上持续进化。

据介绍，新一代大模型可胜任广泛的创意及专业工作，包括3D建模、游戏开发、精密制造、金融、法律、医疗保健，以及前沿科学研究。

中国科技企业在全球开源权重人工智能（AI）模型领域占据重要地位，目前正展开激烈竞争，力求打造性能更强大的系统，同时避免运行成本过高。

阿里巴巴说，在网络安全方面，公司按任务的具体用途筛选，保留用于漏洞验证、检测和修复等防御任务的数据，剔除用于提升攻击能力等进攻任务的数据。

公司称，模型在规避注入、内存安全和越权访问等核心风险上表现尤为突出，能显著减少默认生成的代码漏洞，协助开发者从源头压缩系统受攻击面。

阿里内部安全专家审查发现，Qwen4-Max的网络安全防御能力大幅提升，针对攻击性用途的防护能力也显著增强。阿里也说，尚未发现模型产生大规模网络安全风险的能力。

近几个月来，中国AI模型开发商在发布新模型时，越来越多地披露安全测试情况。此举正值全球对AI“失控”风险的担忧日益加剧，美国科技公司的AI代理此前多次被曝出现失控行为，与中国科技巨头腾讯有关的一款AI代理也于10月被指出现类似问题。

items.summary: 黄仁勋的婚外情秘密是如何泄露到公众视野的 Telegraph | 原文链接 | 频道大全
items.body:
TRIPP MICKLE, ANA SWANSON, 孟建国, JONATHAN SWAN, JULIAN E. BARNES, MAGGIE HABERMAN2026年11月16日

上周四，黄仁勋辞去了英伟达首席执行官的职务。 Mike Kai Chen for The New York Times

Jensen Huang was agitated.

黄仁勋焦躁不安。

It was September 2025, and The New York Times had just called his company about a Singaporean data center firm called Megaspeed that had been led by a Chinese woman named Alice Huang, or Huang Le. The Times was reporting that Mr. Huang, the chief executive of the chip maker Nvidia, had a close relationship with her.

那是2025年9月，《纽约时报》刚刚致电他的公司，询问一家名为Megaspeed的新加坡数据中心公司。该公司曾由一名叫黄乐(Alice Huang)的中国女性领导。《纽约时报》当时报道称，芯片制造商英伟达的首席执行官黄仁勋与她关系密切。

Mr. Huang, who Nvidia employees say could have a volcanic temper, wanted to know what The Times was insinuating. Though he didn’t deny that he knew the woman, he was bothered by the suggestion that they might be close, people familiar with the discussion said.

当时，在英伟达员工口中脾气非常火爆的黄仁勋想知道，《纽约时报》究竟在暗示什么。尽管他没有否认认识这名女性，但他对两人关系可能很密切的暗示感到不满。

Nvidia mounted an aggressive defense. Madison Huang, Mr. Huang’s daughter who acted as her father’s chief of staff, pressed the company’s communications team to push back forcefully. They also had reinforcements, a crisis communications firm called Heller.

英伟达展开了强力辩护。黄仁勋的女儿黄敏珊是父亲的幕僚长，她敦促公司公关部门予以强力反击。此外，他们还得到了危机公关公司Heller的支援。

They insisted that Mr. Huang and the woman from Megaspeed just had a business relationship.

他们坚称，黄仁勋和Megaspeed的那名女性只是业务关系。

Over the next 13 months, Mr. Huang stuck with his story, even after The Times reported last month that the U.S. had gathered intelligence showing that Ms. Huang was secretly working with China’s top spy agency.

接下来的13个月里，黄仁勋坚持这一说法。即使《纽约时报》上个月报道称，美国已收集到情报，显示黄乐秘密为中国最高间谍机构工作，他也没有改变说辞。

But last weekend, facing new revelations about the relationship, Mr. Huang finally came clean to Nvidia’s general counsel. He had been having an affair with the woman, after all, said the people familiar with the discussions.

但上周末，面对有关这段关系的新爆料，黄仁勋终于向英伟达总法律顾问坦白。据熟悉讨论情况的人士透露，他确实曾与黄乐有过婚外情。

The relationship with the Megaspeed executive wasn’t Mr. Huang’s only secret.

与Megaspeed高管的关系并不是黄仁勋唯一的秘密。

On Wednesday, a Times reporter called Mr. Huang to ask him about a second extramarital relationship. This time, it was an affair with an executive who reported to him.

周三，《纽约时报》一名记者致电黄仁勋，询问他关于第二段婚外情的情况。这一次是与一名向他汇报的女性高管。

Nvidia’s board of directors soon convened an emergency meeting to discuss Mr. Huang’s future with his company. Still, it was unimaginable to think of Nvidia without him.

英伟达董事会很快召开紧急会议，讨论黄仁勋在公司的未来。尽管如此，人们仍难以想象没有黄仁勋的英伟达会是什么样子。

Less than 24 hours later, Mr. Huang resigned.

不到24小时后，黄仁勋辞职了。

The revelations about Mr. Huang, 63, set off a cascade of events that have reverberated from Silicon Valley to Washington to Beijing. Administration officials are now reconsidering A.I. export regulations, which could hurt some Silicon Valley businesses but tilt the A.I. race with China decidedly in America’s favor.

关于现年63岁的黄仁勋的这些披露引发了一系列连锁反应，从硅谷到华盛顿、再到北京，都产生了回响。美国政府官员现在正在重新考虑人工智能出口管制，此举虽可能对部分硅谷企业造成冲击，但将使美国在与中国的人工智能竞争中占据明显优势。

It has also brought into public view a feud among several senior administration officials and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. On Friday, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC that his department had been pushing Commerce for months to crack down on the flow of U.S. technology to China.

此事也让几名政府高级官员与商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克之间的不和公开化。周五，财政部长斯科特·贝森特告诉CNBC，他的部门数月来一直敦促商务部打击美国技术流向中国。

Now Nvidia, which was in many ways propping up the A.I. boom, which, in turn, was propping up the U.S. economy, is operating without a man many consider to be one of the most indispensable executives in the history of American business.

如今，英伟达正在缺少一位被许多人视为美国商界历史上最不可或缺的高管的情况下运营。这家公司在许多方面支撑着人工智能热潮，而人工智能热潮又支撑着美国经济。

This is the story — based on a year of reporting, documents and discussions with more than 100 people, including current and former Nvidia executives and government officials who spoke on the condition of anonymity — of how Mr. Huang’s secret slowly spilled into the open.

本文基于一年的报道、文件以及与100余人的访谈——其中包括英伟达现任及前任高管，以及要求匿名接受采访的政府官员——讲述黄仁勋的秘密如何慢慢泄露到公众视野。

What is Megaspeed?

Megaspeed是什么公司？

Last fall, business was booming for Nvidia. Its soaring stock price had it within a whisper of becoming the world’s first $5 trillion company.

去年秋天，英伟达生意兴隆。飙升的股价让它距离成为世界首家市值5万亿美元公司仅一步之遥。

Mr. Huang joined President Trump in September for a formal state dinner at Windsor Castle hosted by King Charles III. Mr. Trump lavished praise on Mr. Huang at a gathering of business and tech leaders hosted by Prime Minister Keir Starmer.

9月，黄仁勋与特朗普总统一同出席查尔斯三世国王在温莎城堡举办的正式国宴。在英国首相斯塔默主持的一场商界和科技领袖聚会上，特朗普对黄仁勋大加赞赏。

“You’re taking over the world, Jensen,” Mr. Trump said.

“你正在接管世界，詹森，”特朗普说。

去年，黄仁勋出席了在温莎城堡为访英的特朗普总统举行的国宴。

But at Nvidia’s headquarters in Santa Clara, Calif., some of Mr. Huang’s advisers were wrestling with The Times’s questions about Megaspeed. The company had purchased more than $2 billion of Nvidia technology in a year, making it one of the largest buyers of A.I. chips in Southeast Asia.

但在英伟达位于加州圣克拉拉的总部，黄仁勋的一些顾问正忙于应对《纽约时报》关于Megaspeed的提问。这家公司在一年内购买了超过20亿美元的英伟达技术，成为东南亚最大的人工智能芯片买家之一。

It was an example of the kind of middlemen popping up across the region. Companies like Megaspeed were legally buying American chips and building A.I. data centers that rented computing power to Chinese companies. But the U.S. government suspected that some, including Megaspeed, were breaking the law by funneling chips to China.

这正是该地区如雨后春笋般涌现的中间商的典型例子。像Megaspeed这样的公司合法购买美国芯片，建设人工智能数据中心，向中国公司出租算力。但美国政府怀疑，包括Megaspeed在内的一些公司正在违法将芯片转运到中国。

Nvidia’s sales from Singapore were swelling. By last summer, the island city-state accounted for 22 percent of the company’s quarterly total sales, or $10 billion, making it the second-largest chip buying region after the United States.

英伟达来自新加坡的销售额不断攀升。到去年夏天，这个城市国家占该公司季度总销售额的22%，即100亿美元，成为仅次于美国的第二大芯片购买地区。

Megaspeed位于马来西亚柔佛州的办公室。

马来西亚柔佛州Megaspeed数据中心园区。

Over the previous two years, Mr. Huang had been seen twice with Ms. Huang in public at industry gatherings. She waited behind him patiently in a pink dress as he passed out noodles from a restaurant in Taipei to onlookers and spoke to the Taiwanese press. Then she climbed into the car with him to be shuttled away.

过去两年里，黄仁勋曾两次与黄乐一同在行业聚会上公开露面。有一次是黄仁勋在台北一家餐厅向围观者分发面条，并与台湾媒体交谈。她穿着粉色连衣裙，耐心地跟在他身后。然后她和他一起上车离开。

A senior Nvidia official told The Times that the dinner attended by Mr. Huang, Ms. Huang and several industry executives was a “business dinner.”

一名英伟达高级官员告诉《纽约时报》，黄仁勋、黄女士和几名行业高管参加的那次晚餐是“商务晚宴”。

On another occasion, Ms. Huang was chatting at an industry party at a Taipei bar when she offered to ask Mr. Huang to join them. “She said, ‘I bet you guys I can get Jensen here,’ and then Jensen immediately showed up,” said Parker Schmitt, who is chief executive of NetThunder, a data software provider. “It should not be an easy job,” he said. “It shouldn’t be a job you take for granted.”

“这不应该是一份轻松的工作，”他说。“这不应该是一份你理所当然该拥有的工作。”

He added that he hoped to be with the company for another 20 years.

他还说，他希望在公司再待20年。

Ryan Mac、Georgia Gee和Kalley Huang对本文有报道贡献。

Tripp Mickle报道英伟达、谷歌和苹果等全球最大的科技公司。他也报道整个科技行业的趋势，包括裁员、生成式AI和机器人出租车等。

Ana Swanson报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。

孟建国(Paul Mozur)是时报全球科技记者，常驻台北。此前，他自香港、上海和首尔报道亚洲科技与政治的交叉议题。

Jonathan Swan是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。

Julian E. Barnes为《纽约时报》报道美国情报机构和国际安全事务。他撰写安全相关议题已有20余年。>

Maggie Haberman是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。

blocks.text: TRIPP MICKLE, ANA SWANSON, 孟建国, JONATHAN SWAN, JULIAN E. BARNES, MAGGIE HABERMAN2026年11月16日
上周四，黄仁勋辞去了英伟达首席执行官的职务。 Mike Kai Chen for The New York Times
Jensen Huang was agitated.
黄仁勋焦躁不安。

It was September 2025, and The New York Times had just called his company about a Singaporean data center firm called Megaspeed that had been led by a Chinese woman named Alice Huang, or Huang Le. The Times was reporting that Mr. Huang, the chief executive of the chip maker Nvidia, had a close relationship with her.
那是2025年9月，《纽约时报》刚刚致电他的公司，询问一家名为Megaspeed的新加坡数据中心公司。该公司曾由一名叫黄乐(Alice Huang)的中国女性领导。《纽约时报》当时报道称，芯片制造商英伟达的首席执行官黄仁勋与她关系密切。

Mr. Huang, who Nvidia employees say could have a volcanic temper, wanted to know what The Times was insinuating. Though he didn’t deny that he knew the woman, he was bothered by the suggestion that they might be close, people familiar with the discussion said.
当时，在英伟达员工口中脾气非常火爆的黄仁勋想知道，《纽约时报》究竟在暗示什么。尽管他没有否认认识这名女性，但他对两人关系可能很密切的暗示感到不满。

Nvidia mounted an aggressive defense. Madison Huang, Mr. Huang’s daughter who acted as her father’s chief of staff, pressed the company’s communications team to push back forcefully. They also had reinforcements, a crisis communications firm called Heller.
英伟达展开了强力辩护。黄仁勋的女儿黄敏珊是父亲的幕僚长，她敦促公司公关部门予以强力反击。此外，他们还得到了危机公关公司Heller的支援。
They insisted that Mr. Huang and the woman from Megaspeed just had a business relationship.
他们坚称，黄仁勋和Megaspeed的那名女性只是业务关系。

Over the next 13 months, Mr. Huang stuck with his story, even after The Times reported last month that the U.S. had gathered intelligence showing that Ms. Huang was secretly working with China’s top spy agency.
接下来的13个月里，黄仁勋坚持这一说法。即使《纽约时报》上个月报道称，美国已收集到情报，显示黄乐秘密为中国最高间谍机构工作，他也没有改变说辞。

But last weekend, facing new revelations about the relationship, Mr. Huang finally came clean to Nvidia’s general counsel. He had been having an affair with the woman, after all, said the people familiar with the discussions.
但上周末，面对有关这段关系的新爆料，黄仁勋终于向英伟达总法律顾问坦白。据熟悉讨论情况的人士透露，他确实曾与黄乐有过婚外情。
The relationship with the Megaspeed executive wasn’t Mr. Huang’s only secret.
与Megaspeed高管的关系并不是黄仁勋唯一的秘密。
On Wednesday, a Times reporter called Mr. Huang to ask him about a second extramarital relationship. This time, it was an affair with an executive who reported to him.
周三，《纽约时报》一名记者致电黄仁勋，询问他关于第二段婚外情的情况。这一次是与一名向他汇报的女性高管。
Nvidia’s board of directors soon convened an emergency meeting to discuss Mr. Huang’s future with his company. Still, it was unimaginable to think of Nvidia without him.
英伟达董事会很快召开紧急会议，讨论黄仁勋在公司的未来。尽管如此，人们仍难以想象没有黄仁勋的英伟达会是什么样子。
Less than 24 hours later, Mr. Huang resigned.
不到24小时后，黄仁勋辞职了。

The revelations about Mr. Huang, 63, set off a cascade of events that have reverberated from Silicon Valley to Washington to Beijing. Administration officials are now reconsidering A.I. export regulations, which could hurt some Silicon Valley businesses but tilt the A.I. race with China decidedly in America’s favor.
关于现年63岁的黄仁勋的这些披露引发了一系列连锁反应，从硅谷到华盛顿、再到北京，都产生了回响。美国政府官员现在正在重新考虑人工智能出口管制，此举虽可能对部分硅谷企业造成冲击，但将使美国在与中国的人工智能竞争中占据明显优势。

It has also brought into public view a feud among several senior administration officials and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. On Friday, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC that his department had been pushing Commerce for months to crack down on the flow of U.S. technology to China.
此事也让几名政府高级官员与商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克之间的不和公开化。周五，财政部长斯科特·贝森特告诉CNBC，他的部门数月来一直敦促商务部打击美国技术流向中国。

Now Nvidia, which was in many ways propping up the A.I. boom, which, in turn, was propping up the U.S. economy, is operating without a man many consider to be one of the most indispensable executives in the history of American business.
如今，英伟达正在缺少一位被许多人视为美国商界历史上最不可或缺的高管的情况下运营。这家公司在许多方面支撑着人工智能热潮，而人工智能热潮又支撑着美国经济。

This is the story — based on a year of reporting, documents and discussions with more than 100 people, including current and former Nvidia executives and government officials who spoke on the condition of anonymity — of how Mr. Huang’s secret slowly spilled into the open.
本文基于一年的报道、文件以及与100余人的访谈——其中包括英伟达现任及前任高管，以及要求匿名接受采访的政府官员——讲述黄仁勋的秘密如何慢慢泄露到公众视野。
What is Megaspeed?
Megaspeed是什么公司？
Last fall, business was booming for Nvidia. Its soaring stock price had it within a whisper of becoming the world’s first $5 trillion company.
去年秋天，英伟达生意兴隆。飙升的股价让它距离成为世界首家市值5万亿美元公司仅一步之遥。

Mr. Huang joined President Trump in September for a formal state dinner at Windsor Castle hosted by King Charles III. Mr. Trump lavished praise on Mr. Huang at a gathering of business and tech leaders hosted by Prime Minister Keir Starmer.
9月，黄仁勋与特朗普总统一同出席查尔斯三世国王在温莎城堡举办的正式国宴。在英国首相斯塔默主持的一场商界和科技领袖聚会上，特朗普对黄仁勋大加赞赏。
“You’re taking over the world, Jensen,” Mr. Trump said.
“你正在接管世界，詹森，”特朗普说。
去年，黄仁勋出席了在温莎城堡为访英的特朗普总统举行的国宴。

But at Nvidia’s headquarters in Santa Clara, Calif., some of Mr. Huang’s advisers were wrestling with The Times’s questions about Megaspeed. The company had purchased more than $2 billion of Nvidia technology in a year, making it one of the largest buyers of A.I. chips in Southeast Asia.
但在英伟达位于加州圣克拉拉的总部，黄仁勋的一些顾问正忙于应对《纽约时报》关于Megaspeed的提问。这家公司在一年内购买了超过20亿美元的英伟达技术，成为东南亚最大的人工智能芯片买家之一。

It was an example of the kind of middlemen popping up across the region. Companies like Megaspeed were legally buying American chips and building A.I. data centers that rented computing power to Chinese companies. But the U.S. government suspected that some, including Megaspeed, were breaking the law by funneling chips to China.
这正是该地区如雨后春笋般涌现的中间商的典型例子。像Megaspeed这样的公司合法购买美国芯片，建设人工智能数据中心，向中国公司出租算力。但美国政府怀疑，包括Megaspeed在内的一些公司正在违法将芯片转运到中国。

Nvidia’s sales from Singapore were swelling. By last summer, the island city-state accounted for 22 percent of the company’s quarterly total sales, or $10 billion, making it the second-largest chip buying region after the United States.
英伟达来自新加坡的销售额不断攀升。到去年夏天，这个城市国家占该公司季度总销售额的22%，即100亿美元，成为仅次于美国的第二大芯片购买地区。
Megaspeed位于马来西亚柔佛州的办公室。
马来西亚柔佛州Megaspeed数据中心园区。

Over the previous two years, Mr. Huang had been seen twice with Ms. Huang in public at industry gatherings. She waited behind him patiently in a pink dress as he passed out noodles from a restaurant in Taipei to onlookers and spoke to the Taiwanese press. Then she climbed into the car with him to be shuttled away.
过去两年里，黄仁勋曾两次与黄乐一同在行业聚会上公开露面。有一次是黄仁勋在台北一家餐厅向围观者分发面条，并与台湾媒体交谈。她穿着粉色连衣裙，耐心地跟在他身后。然后她和他一起上车离开。
A senior Nvidia official told The Times that the dinner attended by Mr. Huang, Ms. Huang and several industry executives was a “business dinner.”
一名英伟达高级官员告诉《纽约时报》，黄仁勋、黄女士和几名行业高管参加的那次晚餐是“商务晚宴”。

On another occasion, Ms. Huang was chatting at an industry party at a Taipei bar when she offered to ask Mr. Huang to join them. “She said, ‘I bet you guys I can get Jensen here,’ and then Jensen immediately showed up,” said Parker Schmitt, who is chief executive of NetThunder, a data software provider. Shortly after, Mr. Huang arrived and drank a whiskey shot with the group. He left the party, which he’d been invited to, shortly afterward with two other Nvidia executives who had joined him.
还有一次，黄乐在台北一家酒吧参加行业聚会时正与人聊天，主动提出请黄仁勋加入他们。“她说，‘我跟你们打赌，我能把詹森叫来’，然后黄仁勋立刻出现了，”数据软件提供商NetThunder首席执行官帕克·施密特说。不久之后，黄仁勋到了，和大家一起喝了一杯威士忌。随后，他与另外两名一同前来的英伟达高管离开了这个他受邀参加的派对。
一张最初发布在领英上的照片显示，2024年，黄仁勋在台北与Megaspeed高管黄乐并肩而坐。

After the article about Megaspeed and Mr. Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang appeared that October, Nvidia changed how it reported geographic sales. Singapore vanished from its financial disclosures as it started reporting sales based on “customers’ headquarters” rather than “billing location.” The company had previously said that large customers billed through Singapore, where taxes can be lower, but that products “are almost always shipped elsewhere.”
那年10月，关于Megaspeed以及黄仁勋与黄乐关系的报道发表后，英伟达改变了报告地区销售的方式。随着公司开始根据“客户总部”而非“账单地点”来报告销售额，新加坡从其财务披露中消失了。公司此前曾表示，大客户通过新加坡开账单，那里税率较低，但产品“几乎总是运往其他地方”。

Late that month, Mr. Huang took a convention center stage in Washington in his signature leather jacket and black jeans. He trumpeted his company’s lead in A.I. chips and praised Mr. Trump for focusing on increasing the nation’s energy supplies. He thanked everyone for their work “making America great again.”
当月下旬，黄仁勋穿着标志性的皮夹克和黑色牛仔裤，登上华盛顿一个会议中心的舞台。他宣扬公司在人工智能芯片领域的领先地位，并赞扬特朗普致力于增加国家能源供应。他感谢所有人为了“让美国再次伟大”所做的工作。

The next day, as Mr. Trump was flying to South Korea to meet with China’s leader Xi Jinping, the president told reporters he was planning to speak to Mr. Xi about Nvidia’s most advanced A.I. chip, known as Blackwell.
第二天，当特朗普飞往韩国与中国领导人习近平会晤时，总统告诉记者，他计划与习近平谈论英伟达最先进的人工智能芯片Blackwell。

Some people in government interpreted Mr. Trump’s comments as a signal that he might lift prohibitions on China’s access to America’s best technology — an outcome that could be a boon to Nvidia’s business, even as it flew in the face of longstanding policy goals to limit China’s access to American technology and protect America’s lead in artificial intelligence. (A White House spokesman declined to comment.)
政府中一些人将特朗普的言论解读为信号：他可能解除中国获得美国顶尖技术的禁令。这一结果可能利好英伟达业务，尽管它与限制中国获得美国技术、保护美国在人工智能领域领先地位的长期政策目标相悖。（白宫发言人拒绝置评。）

The possibilities were huge for Mr. Huang. Though Mr. Trump had cleared the company to sell some of its lower-performing chips to China, Beijing had banned tech companies from buying them. The offer of Blackwell chips had the potential to break that impasse.
这对黄仁勋来说蕴含着巨大的机遇。尽管特朗普已批准公司向中国出售一些性能较低的芯片，但北京禁止科技公司购买。Blackwell芯片的提议有可能打破僵局。
2025年，黄仁勋在参观位于菲尼克斯的台积电芯片制造厂时，手持一块有签名的“Blackwell”晶圆。
But after Cabinet officials, including Secretary of State Marco Rubio and the U.S. trade representative, Jamieson Greer, objected on national security grounds, Mr. Trump abandoned the idea.
但在国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥和美国贸易代表贾米森·格里尔等内阁官员以国家安全为由反对后，特朗普放弃了这一想法。

Roughly a year ago, Mr. Trump was briefed about how American spy agencies had surveillance of Ms. Huang, the Megaspeed executive, whom they had determined was passing information to Chinese intelligence services. The surveillance revealed that she had developed a close relationship with Mr. Huang.
大约一年前，特朗普听取了有关美国间谍机构监视Megaspeed高管黄乐的简报。他们认定她正在向中国情报机构传递信息。监视显示她与黄仁勋发展了亲密关系。

It was an alarming development for national security officials who long worried that Mr. Huang was too nonchalant about concerns that his chips could fall into the hands of the Chinese military or intelligence.
对国家安全官员来说，这是一个令人担忧的事态发展。他们长期担心黄仁勋对其芯片可能落入中国军方或情报部门之手的问题过于漫不经心。

Though Mr. Trump chose not to do anything with the information, it raised questions inside the U.S. government about Mr. Huang’s judgment. It also raised the possibility that Ms. Huang may have gathered insight through Mr. Huang into Mr. Trump’s thinking on artificial intelligence, a vital issue of importance to Washington and Beijing.
尽管特朗普选择不对信息采取任何行动，但它在美国政府内部引发了对黄仁勋判断力的质疑。这同时也引发了一种可能性：黄乐可能通过黄仁勋了解到特朗普在人工智能问题上的想法——这是对华盛顿和北京都至关重要的议题。

For reasons that remain unknown, government officials didn’t tell Mr. Huang about the intelligence. Law enforcement officials sometimes warn Americans who are being targeted by a foreign government’s intelligence service — a practice known as a “defensive briefing.” In weighing whether to give such a warning, officials typically consider the risks of tipping off the target of their own surveillance, which in this case would have been Megaspeed’s Ms. Huang.
出于仍未知的原因，政府官员没有告诉黄仁勋这些情报。执法官员有时会对成为外国政府情报机构目标的美国人做出警告——这种做法被称为“防御性简报”。在权衡是否发出此类警告时，官员通常考虑打草惊蛇的风险，在本案中意味着惊动Megaspeed的黄乐。
Chips for China
对中国出售的芯片

Mr. Huang didn’t abandon his vision of selling chips to China. He continued to argue that that would make Chinese companies depend on American technology and create competition for China’s tech giant, Huawei. It would also be good for his business.
黄仁勋没有放弃向中国出售芯片的愿景。他继续主张，这将使中国公司依赖美国技术，并对中国科技巨头华为形成竞争。这也有利于他的生意。

In December, he returned to Washington to press his case. He met with Mr. Trump at the White House and proposed selling a less powerful chip to China. Known as the H200, it was a generation older than the Blackwell, which was limited to the United States.
12月，他回到华盛顿力推此事。他在白宫会见特朗普，提议向中国出售一款性能较低的芯片。这款名为H200的芯片比仅限美国境内使用的Blackwell芯片落后一代。
Mr. Trump was open to the idea, but he wanted something in return: a 25 percent cut for the U.S. government of any chips sold to China. Mr. Huang agreed.
特朗普对这个想法持开放态度，但他想要回报：美国政府从任何对华销售的芯片中抽取25%。黄仁勋同意了。

By March, pre-purchase orders from Chinese customers were rolling in. At the company’s annual conference in San Jose, Calif., Mr. Huang told a hotel ballroom packed with more than 100 reporters and influencers, including a woman who refers to herself as the “A.I. princess,” that Nvidia was receiving purchase commitments from China and starting to manufacture chips to sell.
3月，中国客户的预购订单滚滚而来。在加州圣何塞的公司年会上，面对把酒店宴会厅挤得满满当当的100多名记者和网红（其中包括一位自称“AI公主”的女性），黄仁勋说英伟达正在收到中国的采购承诺，并开始制造芯片出售。

In Washington, Mr. Rubio started to put together an update about the surveillance of Ms. Huang. The classified memo, based on highly sensitive intelligence, outlined Ms. Huang’s close relationship with the Nvidia founder and her contacts with China’s civilian spy agency, the Ministry of State Security.
在华盛顿，鲁比奥开始整理关于监视黄乐的最新情况。这份基于高度敏感情报的机密备忘录概述了黄乐与英伟达创始人的密切关系，以及她与中国非军事间谍机构国家安全部的接触。

The memo was circulated to only a handful of Cabinet officials. It was sent as the administration made plans for the president to visit Beijing in May for a summit with Mr. Xi. When it came time to extend invitations to more than a dozen chief executives for the trip, Mr. Huang was left off the list.
这份备忘录只分发给了少数内阁官员。发出时，政府正在筹备总统5月访问北京时与习近平的首脑会晤。向十多位首席执行官发出的随行邀请中没有黄仁勋。
But with little warning, Mr. Trump, who had seen news coverage of Mr. Huang’s exclusion, asked the Nvidia executive to meet up with Air Force One at a refueling stop in Alaska.
但看到黄仁勋被排除在外的新闻报道后，特朗普突然要求这位英伟达高管在空军一号经停阿拉斯加加油期间与他会合。
特朗普及其政府成员、包括埃隆·马斯克和黄仁勋在内的科技界高管5月抵达北京。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times

When Mr. Rubio learned of the invitation, while en route to Alaska, he briefed the president on the intelligence showing Mr. Huang had a relationship with a Chinese intelligence asset. Mr. Trump was not particularly moved by the information. Instead, he celebrated Mr. Huang with a social media post after the chief executive boarded the plane, saying it was an honor to have “the Great Jensen Huang” on the trip to China.
在前往阿拉斯加途中得知该邀请的鲁比奥向总统汇报了中国情报线人与黄仁勋有关系的情报。特朗普对这些信息不以为意，反而在黄仁勋登机后上社交媒体发帖赞扬他，称“伟大的黄仁勋”能参加中国之行是荣幸。

On the ground in Beijing, Mr. Trump said he discussed sales of Nvidia chips to China with Mr. Xi. The Chinese government had been reluctant to give its approval to purchases of the less advanced H200 chips. But the conversation didn’t appear to persuade China to allow its companies to buy the Nvidia chips.
在北京，特朗普说他与习近平讨论了向中国销售英伟达芯片的问题。中国政府一直不愿批准购买性能较低的H200芯片。但这次谈话似乎没有说服中国允许其公司购买英伟达芯片。
Some officials in Washington worried that Mr. Huang, to break the impasse, would push for approval to sell the more advanced Blackwells.
华盛顿一些官员担心，黄仁勋为了打破僵局，会推动批准销售更先进的Blackwell芯片。
During Nvidia’s all-hands meeting in August, he was asked what he considered to be Nvidia’s greatest risk.
在英伟达8月的全员大会上，有人问他认为英伟达最大的风险是什么。
“It’s Washington, D.C.,” he said. “Policies that are made that are uninformed affect us, and they could affect us in a business way, and that could be irritating and frustrating.”
“是华盛顿，”他说。“不了解情况的人制定的政策会影响我们，可能在商业层面上影响我们，这可能令人恼火和沮丧。”
Midway through the meeting, his phone buzzed.
会议进行到一半，他的电话响了。
“There are only two people in the world that can call me,” he said. “One of them is President Trump.”
“世界上只有两个人能给我打电话，”他说。“其中一个是特朗普总统。”
He picked up Mr. Trump’s call and stepped away.
他接了特朗普的电话，走开了。
The secret slips
秘密泄露
Mr. Huang didn’t know it, but his secret was starting to spill.
黄仁勋不知道，他的秘密正在泄露。

Late last month, The Times reached out to Nvidia for comment on a report that would publicly reveal for the first time that Ms. Huang was being surveilled. U.S. intelligence had believed she was an asset for Chinese intelligence who was feeding information to Beijing and was in a close relationship with Mr. Huang. (Among U.S. intelligence and national security officials, the relationship was routinely described more pointedly as an affair. )
上个月底，《纽约时报》联系英伟达，就一篇将首次披露黄乐正被监视的报道寻求置评。美国情报机构认为她是向北京传递信息的中国情报线人，并与黄仁勋关系密切。（在美国情报和国家安全官员中，这段关系常被更直白地描述为婚外情。）

Even after The Times reported in October 2025 that Megaspeed was under investigation for smuggling chips into China, Nvidia had kept doing business with the company. And Mr. Huang had kept up his relationship with Ms. Huang, according to U.S. officials who reviewed the intelligence.
即使《纽约时报》2025年10月报道Megaspeed因涉嫌向中国走私芯片而受到调查后，英伟达仍继续与该公司做生意。据曾审阅情报的美国官员说，黄仁勋也继续保持与黄乐的关系。

Megaspeed’s sister company in Malaysia bought at least $4.8 billion worth of advanced A.I. equipment containing Nvidia chips and technology from June 2024 to February 2026, according to trade records obtained from ImportGenius, a trade platform.
根据从贸易平台ImportGenius获得的贸易记录，Megaspeed在马来西亚的姊妹公司从2024年6月到2026年2月购买了至少价值48亿美元的先进AI设备，其中包含英伟达芯片和技术。
Mr. Huang told people around him that it was the first time he was learning that the U.S. government had been tracking his relationship with Ms. Huang.
黄仁勋告诉身边的人，这是他第一次得知美国政府一直在追踪他与黄乐的关系。
黄仁勋的女儿黄敏珊是英伟达产品营销高级总监。

Nvidia insisted that the company that employed Ms. Huang, Megaspeed, was like any other regional customer and that it had previously investigated and debunked claims that the Singaporean company was smuggling chips to China.
英伟达坚称，雇用黄乐的Megaspeed就是该地区的一个普通客户，公司此前已经调查并驳斥了这家新加坡公司向中国走私芯片的说法。
(China has rejected the espionage claims. Alice Huang, the Chinese executive accused of spying for Beijing, has not responded to requests for comment.)
（中国否认了间谍指控。被指控为北京从事间谍活动的中国高管黄乐未回应置评请求。）
Mr. Huang jumped to his own defense. In an interview with Bloomberg News, he said that his interactions with Ms. Huang had been “all completely normal and not unusual.”
黄仁勋立即做出了自辩。在接受彭博新闻采访时，他说他与黄乐的互动“完全正常，并不罕见”。

Other outlets jumped on the story. Nvidia roped in Heller, the crisis communications firm that had been working for the Huang family since early 2025, to help once again. The company represents high-profile individuals, with past clients including Harvey Weinstein and Anthony Weiner, as well as the business side of The Times.
其他媒体纷纷跟进。英伟达再次拉来Heller——这家危机公关公司自2025年初以来一直为黄家工作。Heller代理知名人物，过去的客户包括哈维·韦恩斯坦和安东尼·韦纳，以及《纽约时报》的商业部门。
On Nov. 6, The Times reported on Mr. Rubio’s memo and said U.S. intelligence had identified her as working with the Chinese intelligence service.
11月6日，《纽约时报》报道了鲁比奥的备忘录，并称美国情报机构已确认她为中国情报机构工作。
Later that night, The Financial Times reported the U.S. government believed Mr. Huang’s relationship with the woman was romantic. Nvidia declined to comment.
当晚晚些时候，《金融时报》报道称美国政府认为黄仁勋与这名女性的关系是情人关系。英伟达拒绝置评。
Tim Teter, Nvidia’s general counsel, who had been defending Mr. Huang, went to Mr. Huang’s house in Woodside, Calif. Mr. Huang confessed, said people familiar with the events that night.
一直为黄仁勋辩护的英伟达总法律顾问蒂姆·泰特前往黄仁勋位于加州伍德赛德的家中。知情人士说，黄仁勋坦白了。

Madison, his daughter, was flying to South Korea at the time. She was scheduled to participate in an A.I. event and meet local dignitaries. But the moment she landed, she was told the news and encouraged to fly back home.
他的女儿黄敏珊当时正飞往韩国。她原定参加一场AI活动并会见当地政要。但她一落地就被告知消息，并被建议飞回家。

Mr. Huang’s betrayal caused deep pain inside Nvidia. His family — including Madison; his son, Spencer; and son-in-law Nico Caprez — worked in prominent roles at the company. He had been married to Lori Huang for more than 40 years.
黄仁勋的背叛在英伟达内部造成深切的痛苦。他的家人——包括黄敏珊、儿子黄胜斌和女婿尼科·卡普雷斯——都在公司担任重要职务。他与洛丽·黄结婚40多年。
9月，在白宫为中国国家主席习近平举行的国宴上，黄仁勋（中）、他的妻子洛丽以及刚刚卸任苹果公司首席执行官一职的蒂姆·库克一同出席。

After Mr. Huang’s confession, Mr. Teter urged Nvidia’s board to act. The board and Mr. Huang separately drafted public statements. The board said it “had full confidence in Jensen,” even as it planned to hire an outside law firm to investigate the matter.
黄仁勋坦白后，泰特敦促英伟达董事会采取行动。董事会和黄仁勋分别起草公开声明。董事会表示“对黄仁勋充满信心”，同时计划聘请外部律师事务所调查此事。
Mr. Huang apologized in a message to the company. “I was unfaithful to my wife,” he said. “My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.”
黄仁勋在公司内部消息中道歉。“我对妻子不忠，”他说。“我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我所做的事没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”

He promised that he would earn back the confidence of employees and the board. Privately, he assured people around him, including Mr. Teter, who spoke with the board, that there were no other infidelities.
他承诺将赢回员工和董事会的信任。私下里，他向包括与董事会沟通的泰特在内的人保证，没有其他不忠行为。
Bloomberg News earlier reported on Mr. Teter’s visit. The Information, a technology news site, earlier reported on the board’s deliberations.
彭博新闻此前报道了泰特的到访。科技新闻网站The Information此前报道了董事会的审议。

Over the next few days, Mr. Huang received texts and calls of encouragement from friends, such as Elon Musk of Tesla and SpaceX, OpenAI’s Sam Altman and the financier Larry Fink. President Trump also called him on Tuesday with a word of advice: Fight.
接下来几天，黄仁勋收到朋友的鼓励短信和电话，如特斯拉和SpaceX的埃隆·马斯克、OpenAI的萨姆·奥特曼和金融家拉里·芬克。特朗普总统周二也打电话给他，给了一句建议：战斗。
Some allies began to make plans to turn the tide. Mr. Huang told many of them that the woman wasn’t a spy. She was just a business customer.
一些盟友开始计划扭转局面。黄仁勋告诉他们中的许多人，黄乐不是间谍。她只是商业客户。

But four days later, The Times contacted the company and Mr. Huang about another affair. This one was with a woman who directly reported to him, Kimberly Powell, a 48-year-old who led Nvidia’s health division. The two had been caught on camera in an affectionate moment during Nvidia’s annual conference in San Jose.
但四天后，《纽约时报》联系公司和黄仁勋，询问另一段婚外情。这次是与直接向他汇报的英伟达健康部门负责人、48岁的金伯利·鲍威尔。两人在圣何塞英伟达年会上被拍到有亲密举动。
The company declined to comment. Mr. Huang, who was reached by phone, said, “I don’t think you should be talking to me directly.” Then, he hung up.
公司拒绝置评。通过电话联系到的黄仁勋说：“我认为你不应该直接跟我谈。”然后挂了电话。
After the news broke, the 10-member board called an emergency meeting. Members called in from remote locations and deliberated over a decision none of them ever thought they would have to make.
消息传出后，10人董事会召开紧急会议。董事们从各地远程接入，研究一个他们从未想过必须做出的决定。

The revelation of another infidelity showed that Mr. Huang, who had extolled the company’s code of conduct rules over the years, had been violating them. First, there was the relationship with a customer. Then, there was the relationship with an employee.
另一段婚外情的曝光表明，多年来一直推崇公司行为准则的黄仁勋一直在违反这些准则。首先是与客户的关系。然后是与员工的关系。
But in the world of corporate governance, the worst thing a chief executive can do is lie, especially in a crisis. It is a reason they get fired.
但在公司治理世界里，首席执行官能做的最糟糕的事就是撒谎，尤其是在危机中。这是他们被解雇的原因之一。
On Thursday morning, the company said Mr. Huang had resigned. The board had named Colette Kress, the company’s chief financial officer, as interim chief executive officer.
周四上午，公司表示黄仁勋已辞职。董事会任命公司首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯为临时首席执行官。
Mr. Huang would have to surrender his life’s work.
黄仁勋将不得不放弃他毕生经营的企业。
In a series of extensive interviews last month with Emily Chang of Bloomberg TV, Mr. Huang acknowledged it was a high pressure role that required sacrifice.
在上个月与彭博电视台艾米丽·张的一系列详尽访谈中，黄仁勋承认这是一个需要牺牲的高压角色。
“It should not be an easy job,” he said. “It shouldn’t be a job you take for granted.”
“这不应该是一份轻松的工作，”他说。“这不应该是一份你理所当然该拥有的工作。”
He added that he hoped to be with the company for another 20 years.
他还说，他希望在公司再待20年。
Ryan Mac、Georgia Gee和Kalley Huang对本文有报道贡献。
Tripp Mickle报道英伟达、谷歌和苹果等全球最大的科技公司。他也报道整个科技行业的趋势，包括裁员、生成式AI和机器人出租车等。
Ana Swanson报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。
孟建国(Paul Mozur)是时报全球科技记者，常驻台北。此前，他自香港、上海和首尔报道亚洲科技与政治的交叉议题。
Jonathan Swan是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。
Julian E. Barnes为《纽约时报》报道美国情报机构和国际安全事务。他撰写安全相关议题已有20余年。>
Maggie Haberman是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。

北大399元人民币羽绒服走红卖断货 网民纷求代购

北方进入冬季，知名高校北京大学一款售价399元、含绒量达90%的羽绒服近期在中国网络走红。这款羽绒服目前已卖断货，不少网民在社交媒体上留言求代购。

《北京日报》星期一（11月16日）报道，北大校内文创店内游客源源不断，服饰货架前的通道尤其拥挤，一直有游客举着社媒上的热门帖子咨询：“白色羽绒服还有吗？”

工作人员则一遍遍解释：“这件新款羽绒服正在补货，预计12月底到货，可以关注北大文创线上平台获取最新消息。”

据介绍，这件羽绒服填充物为鹅绒，绒子含量达90%。有消费者称，其充绒量和保暖性能与市面上一些热销品牌相当，但售价却只有其一半左右，性价比非常突出。

话题“北大399元羽绒服全网刷屏”星期一冲上微博热搜第一。据悉，羽绒服一经推出便迅速售罄，校内文创店的白色款率先断货，目前仅剩黑色和紫色款。

综合《新民晚报》、温度新闻等报道，不少抢到第一波现货的学生发布了“买家秀”，评论里求代购的呼声一片。据悉，大量涌入北大文创微信小程序抢购的网民把小程序挤崩，不少用户反馈页面打不开、没法下单。

北大文创客服回应，这两天访问人数太多，问题已经同步给技术人员，稍等一段时间就能恢复。

报道引述分析称，除了自带名校光环，高校文创也解决了消费市场里的“信任难题”——一所高校用多年来积累的社会声誉为文创做背书，消费者不需要花大量精力去对比测评，就对产品品质多了一份放心。

有网民留言称，这款羽绒服使用鹅绒，“用这么好”；也有人说：“看看吧，根本不缺市场，缺的只是良心商家。”

英媒曝意大利反对德国参与日英意战机计划

关于日本、英国和意大利共同推进的下一代战机开发项目“全球战斗航空计划”（GCAP），英国《金融时报》（FT）14日报道称，意大利反对德国新加入该计划。另一方面，意大利国防部则发表了表示“欢迎德国参加”的声明，否认了报道内容。

据FT报道，意大利希望德国作为观察员参加，还称日本也对德国的加入持谨慎态度。

德国已展示了加入GCAP的意愿。据FT报道，在本月举行的日英意防长视频会议上，意大利国防部长克罗塞托表示强烈反对。意方担心利益协调等可能导致项目开发延迟，且德国企业的加入会减少分配给本国企业的作业份额。

由于观察员国家不参与设计和开发，因此德国官员表示“无法接受”意大利的提议。英国曾对德国加入展示了积极态度。

加拿大目前作为观察员参与GCAP。据悉，鉴于未来可能引进该机型，该计划相关的部分机密信息将向加拿大共享。

高市抵达菲律宾 将出席东盟会议

日本首相高市早苗为出席东盟（ASEAN）相关首脑会议，16日乘坐政府专机抵达菲律宾马尼拉。日美澳印“四边机制”（Quad）首脑会议也将举行。着眼于美中俄三国首脑会谈，日方还将摸索高市与美国总统特朗普进行个别对话。高市之后将前往中国深圳，出席亚太经合组织（APEC）首脑会议。

高市启程前在公邸接受媒体采访。她就东盟相关首脑会议强调：“希望进一步与作为‘自由开放的印度太平洋’关键的东盟加强合作。”关于APEC，她表示将就贸易、投资、提升能源韧性、人工智能（AI）等课题进行磋商，“有力地阐述日本的立场”。

在马尼拉期间，高市17日将出席日本与东盟首脑会议、日中韩与东盟首脑会议以及东亚峰会（EAS）。为实现“自由开放的印太”，她有意在能源安全及应对高性能AI等问题上与参会国家开展合作。

高市17日下午将与韩国总统李在明会谈，还将分别与菲律宾总统马科斯、泰国总理阿努廷进行会谈。

高市18日起将造访深圳。由于日中关系恶化，与中国国家主席习近平进行正式会谈的形势较为困难，高市将寻求对话机会。是否会与俄罗斯总统普京接触也是外界关注的焦点。她将于19日下午举行面向国内外媒体的记者会，之后回国。
